We ran three arms (the harness with the index, the same harness without it, and an agentic-grep comparator) on SWE-PolyBench Verified and SWE-bench Pro with Claude Opus 4.7 held fixed throughout, across three seeds, inside a l

summary.core_problem: 现有代码Agent的检索模块实现差异极大，从简单的agentic grep到融合依赖图、语义向量的复杂索引不等，但始终缺少严格控制变量的验证：在固定模型、固定Agent控制回路与工具集的前提下，结构化代码库索引（融合语义、词法、调用图的混合索引）相比纯grep检索是否能提升任务解决率、是否会引入额外成本。过往评测大多混淆检索模块与prompt设计、工具集、控制逻辑的差异，或仅单独评测检索召回率而不衡量端到端任务解决效果，且普遍存在基准数据泄露问题导致分数虚高。
summary.importance: 目前少有的经过严格泄漏审计、固定模型与全链路控制变量的代码Agent检索模块因果消融实验显示，结构化索引并非冗余开销，在多文件修改场景下的定位收益可稳定转化为端到端解决率提升，且不会带来额外成本。相关结论对代码模型预训练的数据组织、长上下文检索设计、Agent工具链搭建有实际参考价值；实验采用的严格变量控制、泄漏审计、因果对照设计，也为后续Agent组件评测提供了可复现的操作范式。
summary.technical_approach: 实验采用严格控制变量设计，所有测试组统一使用Claude Opus 4.7模型，设置三组对照：1）SC-ON：SuperCoder Agent框架开启结构化上下文引擎，引擎包含三类索引组件：代码块向量语义索引、基于tree-sitter解析的定义/调用边结构图索引、标识符BM25词法索引，索引按仓库一次性构建，通过Merkle树差异做增量更新；2）SC-OFF：使用完全相同的框架、prompt、基础工具集，仅移除两个索引专属工具（codebase_search、codebase_graph）；3）OpenCode：仅依赖agentic grep做检索的对照Agent框架。所有实验在加固的单任务沙箱中运行，实验后做全量泄漏审计，排除样本记忆、题面信息泄露等污染样本，在SWE-PolyBench Verified与SWE-bench Pro共91个多语言任务上运行3个随机种子，统计文件定位准确率、端到端解决率、单任务成本、单解决任务平均成本。
summary.experiments: 组内消融（SC-ON vs SC-OFF）显示，开启结构化索引后，View B acc@5（相关文件定位准确率）从44.3%提升至84.5%（配对Wilcoxon检验p<0.0001，统计显著），端到端任务解决率从41.9%提升至50.4%（p=0.003，统计显著）；单任务平均成本无统计显著差异，单解决任务平均成本更低（SC-ON为$2.30，基于grep的OpenCode基线为$2.92）。跨框架对照（SC-ON vs OpenCode）显示，SC-ON解决率为50.4%，OpenCode为45.3%（p=0.087，边缘显著），定位准确率84.5% vs 75.3%（p=0.080，边缘显著），无成本倒退。索引的收益集中在多文件修改的复杂任务，单文件简单任务上grep检索已能达到足够效果。实验全量结果、排除样本台账、泄漏审计脚本均随结果开源，可完整复现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言中对过往代码Agent评测存在的混淆因素的梳理，实验设计部分的控制变量方法与泄漏审计流程，以及结果部分的异质性分析（索引生效与失效的场景边界）。索引的具体实现细节可快速浏览，无需深读，预计阅读时间15分钟。从事代码Agent或代码检索研发的读者可参考附录中的泄漏审计脚本与结果统计台账。

summary_en.core_problem: Coding agent deployments use highly heterogeneous retrieval implementations, ranging from simple agentic grep to complex hybrid indices combining semantic embeddings, lexical search, and call graphs, but no rigorously controlled measurement exists to isolate the causal effect of structural codebase indices on end-to-end resolve rate and cost when model, control loop, and tool surface are held fixed. Prior evaluations either compare full agent harnesses (confounding retrieval effects with prompt design, tool sets, and control logic) or measure retrieval recall in isolation without tracking downstream task resolution, and many suffer from benchmark leakage that inflates reported scores.
summary_en.importance: Rigorous, leak-audited, model-fixed causal ablation of a production structural codebase index shows structural indices are not redundant overhead: localization gains on multi-file edit tasks translate to consistent end-to-end resolve rate improvements with no added cost. These findings carry practical implications for code LLM pretraining (particularly data organization and retrieval-augmented code modeling), long-context retrieval design, and agent toolchain development. The strict variable control, leak auditing, and causal contrast design also set a reproducible standard for future agent component evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach: A strict controlled experimental design uses Claude Opus 4.7 across all test arms, with three conditions: 1) SC-ON: the SuperCoder agent harness with structural context engine enabled, combining three index components: chunk-level vector semantic index, tree-sitter parsed definition/call graph for structural reachability, and BM25 lexical index over identifiers; indices are built once per repository with incremental updates via Merkle tree diffs. 2) SC-OFF: identical harness, prompt, and base tool set, with only the two index-specific tools removed. 3) OpenCode: a baseline agent harness relying solely on agentic grep for retrieval. All runs execute in hardened per-task sandboxes, with post-run leak audits to exclude memorized instances and issue text leakage. Tests run on 91 multi-language tasks from SWE-PolyBench Verified and SWE-bench Pro across 3 random seeds, measuring file localization accuracy, end-to-end resolve rate, per-task cost, and average cost per resolved task.
summary_en.experiments: Within-harness ablation (SC-ON vs SC-OFF): enabling the structural index raises View B acc@5 localization from 44.3% to 84.5% (paired Wilcoxon p<0.0001) and end-to-end resolve rate from 41.9% to 50.4% (p=0.003), with no statistically significant difference in per-task cost and lower cost per resolved task ($2.30 average for SC-ON vs $2.92 for the grep-based OpenCode baseline). Cross-harness comparison (SC-ON vs OpenCode): SC-ON achieves slightly higher resolve rate (50.4% vs 45.3%, p=0.087) and localization accuracy (84.5% vs 75.3%, p=0.080) with no cost regression. Gains are concentrated on multi-file change tasks; simple single-file tasks show no meaningful difference between index and grep-based retrieval. All raw results, exclusion ledgers, and leak audit scripts are released for full reproducibility.
summary_en.reading_guide: For casual reading, focus on the introduction's breakdown of confounding factors in prior coding agent evaluations, the experimental design section covering control variables and leak audit procedures, and the heterogeneity analysis of results identifying scenarios where indices provide benefit versus where grep is sufficient. Low-level index implementation details can be skimmed. Expected reading time: 15 minutes. Readers working on coding agents or code retrieval may reference the released leak audit scripts and results ledger for evaluation design guidance.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和消融表即可；它对 pretrain 不直接，但给 repo 级检索组件评估立了较干净的样板。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental design and ablation tables; not a pretraining paper, but a clean template for evaluating repo-level retrieval components.

paper.title: AgentLens: Interpretable Safety Steering via Mechanistic Subspaces for Multi-Turn Coding Agent
paper.abstract: Coding agents based on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable autonomous capabilities, but they also introduce significant safety and misuse risks during multi-turn interactions with external environments. Existing safety mechanisms mainly rely on external guardrails, which have a limited ability to perform fine-grained behavioral control during execution. Meanwhile, recent mechanistic interpretability methods for LLM safety are mostly confined to single-turn or jailbreak-style QA s

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮 coding agent 在执行外部环境操作时，传统外部 guardrail 难以及时、细粒度控制风险行为的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 安全方法与可解释干预。它把 mechanistic interpretability 从单轮 jailbreak/QA 场景扩展到多轮 agent 执行轨迹，对研究 agent 内部风险状态有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentLens，即 Mechanistic Subspace Intervention and Steering。方法从 step-level hidden representations 中检测有害执行状态，并在运行时通过表示子空间干预进行缓解，而不是只依赖输入输出过滤器或外部执行规则。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、benchmark 名称或提升幅度。可确认的是实验对象是多轮 coding agent，并强调运行时安全检测与 representation-level mitigation；具体效果需要看正文表格。
summary.authors_note: Chaowei Xiao 是安全与对抗机器学习方向的知名研究者，近年也关注大模型安全与鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets safety risks in multi-turn coding agents, where external guardrails often fail to provide fine-grained control during execution.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent safety and interpretability contribution. It extends mechanistic safety work beyond single-turn jailbreak or QA settings into multi-step agent execution, where risk evolves across actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentLens performs Mechanistic Subspace Intervention and Steering. It detects harmful execution states from step-level hidden representations and applies representation-level runtime mitigation, rather than relying solely on external filters or guardrails.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, benchmark names, or numerical gains. It claims evaluation on multi-turn coding agents with runtime safety detection and mitigation; the main evidence would need to be checked in the full experimental section.
summary_en.authors_note: Chaowei Xiao is a well-known researcher in adversarial machine learning, robustness, and more recent LLM safety work.

recommendation.zh: agent 安全方向可备查；预训练视角只需看子空间定义，实验若没有强消融就别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Worth filing for agent safety; from a pretraining lens, only inspect the subspace definition and avoid over-reading it without strong ablations.

paper.title: CodeTeam: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Code Generation
paper.abstract: Natural language to repository generation (NL2Repo) requires a system to construct an entire software repository from a natural-language requirements document. Compared with function-level code generation, this task demands longer planning horizons, stable interfaces across files, and iterative debugging of cross-file inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we propose CodeTeam, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that separates planning, decision making, and implementation into distinct, co

summary.core_problem: 解决自然语言到完整软件仓库生成（NL2Repo）中长程规划、跨文件接口一致性与迭代调试的核心挑战
summary.importance: 代码Agent架构创新，提出多角色分离的多Agent协作框架，为仓库级代码生成提供新范式
summary.technical_approach: CodeTeam框架分三阶段：多Architect agent生成竞争的软件设计草图，CTO agent筛选并规范化为可机器检查的接口契约，Developer agent按依赖调度生成代码，配合轻量Git协作机制
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体使用的LLM模型、测试数据集与基线效果对比的量化结果

summary_en.core_problem: Address core challenges of long-horizon planning, cross-file interface consistency and iterative debugging in NL2Repo (natural language to full software repository generation)
summary_en.importance: Coding agent architecture innovation, proposes a role-separated multi-agent collaboration framework as a new paradigm for repository-level code generation
summary_en.technical_approach: CodeTeam has three stages: multiple Architect agents draft competing software design sketches, CTO agent selects and normalizes them into machine-checkable interface contracts, Developer agents generate code under dependency-aware scheduler with lightweight Git coordination
summary_en.experiments: No specific LLM models, test datasets or quantitative baseline comparison results disclosed in abstract

recommendation.zh: 仓库级代码生成的多Agent角色划分有参考价值，仅看框架图Fig1和§3的流程设计即可
recommendation.en: Role-separated multi-agent design for repo-level code generation is reference-worthy; only check Fig 1 and §3 pipeline design.

paper.title: Revelio: Cost-Efficient Agentic Memory Safety Vulnerability Detection For Repository-Scale Codebases
paper.abstract: Memory safety vulnerabilities remain a significant threat even for projects with extensive fuzzing and manual auditing. Recent results suggest that large language models hold great promise for detecting such vulnerabilities, but they are unreliable, at risk of hallucination, and challenging to scale to repository-size codebases. This paper presents Revelio, a cost-efficient end-to-end agentic framework for memory-safety vulnerability discovery. Revelio addresses the problem of hallucination by g

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM进行仓库级内存安全漏洞检测存在幻觉严重、结果不可靠、成本高难以规模化的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新+工程突破，提出端到端agent框架，通过可执行漏洞证明+静态分析+廉价LLM的组合实现低幻觉、低成本的仓库级漏洞检测，为代码类任务的幻觉抑制提供了可落地思路。
summary.technical_approach: 原创Revelio框架：1）用廉价LLM搭配轻量静态分析生成并排序漏洞假设，控制调用成本；2）要求agent生成可执行的漏洞证明（PoV），通过确定性sanitizer验证，仅输出验证通过的结果以消除幻觉；3）分级调度模型与分析模块优化效率。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖7个经5-8年持续fuzz的生产级代码库、CyberGym基准的100个随机Arvo项目，验证了漏洞检测的有效性与成本效率（原摘要实验部分截断，无具体量化结果）。
summary.authors_note: 核心作者来自加州大学伯克利分校（UC Berkeley），Dawn Song为AI安全与大模型领域知名学者，David Wagner为系统安全领域权威，Koushik Sen为软件工程领域专家。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-based repository-scale memory safety vulnerability detection suffers from severe hallucinations, unreliable results, and high costs that hinder scalability.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation and engineering breakthrough; proposes an end-to-end agent framework that achieves low-hallucination, low-cost repository-level vulnerability detection via the combination of executable vulnerability proofs, static analysis, and inexpensive LLMs, providing implementable ideas for hallucination suppression in code tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Original Revelio framework: 1) uses inexpensive LLMs paired with lightweight static analysis to generate and rank vulnerability hypotheses to control invocation costs; 2) requires agents to generate executable Proof-of-Vulnerability (PoV) verified by a deterministic sanitizer, only outputting validated results to eliminate hallucinations; 3) hierarchically schedules models and analysis modules to optimize efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 7 production-grade codebases continuously fuzzed for 5-8 years and 100 random Arvo projects from the CyberGym benchmark, validating the effectiveness and cost efficiency of vulnerability detection (experiment section truncated in original abstract, no specific quantitative results).
summary_en.authors_note: Core authors are from UC Berkeley; Dawn Song is a leading scholar in AI security and large models, David Wagner is an authority in systems security, and Koushik Sen is an expert in software engineering.

recommendation.zh: 核心价值是“用确定性验证器过滤幻觉”的工程思路，可迁移到代码LLM的RL奖励设计，读§3框架部分即可。
recommendation.en: Core value lies in the engineering idea of filtering hallucinations with deterministic verifiers, which can be transferred to RL reward design for coding LLMs; read §3 for framework design.

paper.title: From Fragments to Paths: Task-Level Context Recovery for Large Industrial Codebases
paper.abstract: Large language models have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, yet understanding large industrial repositories remains challenging. Existing methods often retrieve only local fragments and fail to recover the broader task-relevant context needed for complex repository-level tasks. We present DeepDiscovery, a task-level repository-understanding method for large industrial codebases. DeepDiscovery uses a two-stage \textit{Location--Inference} framework to localize high-con

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在大型工业代码库中只检索局部片段、难以恢复任务级上下文，导致仓库级软件工程任务表现受限的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码智能与仓库级上下文恢复方法；它不是预训练工作，但对代码模型和 SWE agent 的检索上下文设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DeepDiscovery，采用两阶段 Location-Inference 框架：先定位高置信任务锚点，再沿多关系仓库结构在预算约束下恢复更广的任务相关上下文。方法重点不是生成更强代码模型，而是改进 repo-level context construction。
summary.experiments: 实验包括受控 method-level evaluation、组织内部工业仓库理解场景，以及 SWE-bench Verified 的端到端评测。摘要称在 27 个中等规模任务上，DeepDiscovery 在五个代表性基线中取得最佳文件恢复质量，并提升下游软件工程表现；未提供具体提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles task-level context recovery for LLM-based software engineering in large industrial repositories, where local-fragment retrieval misses broader repository context.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a repository-understanding method for coding agents. It is not pretraining work, but it is relevant to code-model evaluation and context construction for SWE agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeepDiscovery uses a two-stage Location-Inference framework: it first identifies high-confidence task anchors, then expands over multi-relational repository structure under a context budget to recover broader task-relevant files.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers controlled method-level tests, internal industrial repository-understanding scenarios, and end-to-end SWE-bench Verified experiments. The abstract reports best file-recovery quality among five representative baselines on 27 medium-scale tasks and improved downstream SE performance, without giving exact numbers.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练没直接动作项；只看 Location-Inference 设计和 SWE-bench 端到端结果，作为代码 agent 检索备查。
recommendation.en: No direct pretraining action item; read only the Location-Inference design and SWE-bench results as a reference for coding-agent retrieval.

paper.title: Library-Aware Doubles and Iterative Repair for Large Language Model-Generated Unit Tests in OpenSIL Firmware
paper.abstract: Validating changes in low-level C firmware is expensive because unit tests (UTs) are fragile under strict build constraints, where missing headers, unresolved symbols, and dependency mismatches frequently prevent compilation and linking. This study introduces an automated UT authoring workflow for the Open-Source Silicon Initialization Library (openSIL) firmware codebase maintained by Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) that reduces manual effort through a large language model (LLM) guided multi-agent

summary.core_problem: 低级别C固件的单元测试编写成本高，LLM生成的测试常因头文件缺失、符号未解析、依赖不匹配等严格编译约束无法通过编译链接
summary.importance: 工程创新+方法改进：提出首个针对AMD OpenSIL固件的LLM驱动多Agent单元测试生成工作流，引入库感知的依赖处理与迭代修复机制，大幅降低手动测试编写成本
summary.technical_approach: 多Agent流水线：1）自动生成测试脚手架；2）库感知地创建或复用stub/mock/fake解决固件依赖问题；3）基于构建日志与行覆盖率反馈的迭代编译-分发-修复循环，逐步修正测试中的编译与逻辑错误
summary.experiments: 在AMD维护的OpenSIL代码库的76个被测函数上评估，成功生成73个可编译单元测试；以编译成功率、修复迭代次数、分发成功率、行覆盖率为核心指标，时间、成本、token用量为次要指标（原文摘要截断，未给出完整配置下的详细量化结果与Baseline对比）
summary.authors_note: AMD（超威半导体）团队，工作针对AMD维护的开源硅初始化库OpenSIL开展，为工业级落地实践

summary_en.core_problem: Authoring unit tests for low-level C firmware is costly, and LLM-generated tests often fail to compile and link due to strict build constraints such as missing headers, unresolved symbols, and dependency mismatches
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation + methodological improvement: proposes the first LLM-driven multi-agent unit test authoring workflow for AMD's OpenSIL firmware, introducing library-aware dependency handling and iterative repair mechanisms to significantly reduce manual testing effort
summary_en.technical_approach: Multi-agent pipeline: 1) automatically generate test scaffolds; 2) library-aware creation or reuse of stubs, mocks, and fakes to resolve firmware dependencies; 3) iterative compile-dispatch-repair loop driven by build logs and line coverage feedback to gradually fix compilation and logic errors in tests
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 76 functions under test in AMD-maintained OpenSIL codebase, generating compilable unit tests for 73 functions; core metrics include compilation success rate, repair iterations, dispatch success rate, and line coverage, with time, cost, and token usage as secondary metrics (the abstract is truncated, detailed quantitative results under full configurations and baseline comparisons are not provided)
summary_en.authors_note: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) team; the work is conducted for AMD-maintained Open-Source Silicon Initialization Library (OpenSIL), representing an industrial-grade practice

recommendation.zh: AMD固件单元测试生成的工程实践，仅关注低级别代码Coding Agent的研究员可扫方法部分，无预训练相关insight
recommendation.en: AMD's industrial practice of firmware unit test generation; only low-level code coding agent researchers need to skim the method section, no pretraining-related insights

paper.title: AutoPass: Evidence-Guided LLM Agents for Compiler Performance Tuning
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for code compilation tasks, but applying them to runtime performance tuning is difficult due to complex microarchitectural effects and noisy runtime measurements. We present AutoPass, a multi-agent framework for compiler performance tuning that uses compiler and runtime evidence to guide LLM-generated optimization decisions. Rather than treating the compiler as a black box like prior auto-tuning schemes, AutoPass opens up the compiler to the LLM, enablin

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 用于编译器性能调优时难以处理微架构效应、运行时噪声和编译器内部状态不可见的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent / compiler agent 方法创新。它不推进基座预训练，但提供了一个较干净的 tool-use 场景：LLM 不只生成代码或参数，而是读取编译器内部证据并闭环修正。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoPass，多 Agent 框架在无需训练和无需微调的 inference-only 设置下运行。系统允许 LLM 查询编译器内部优化状态、分析中间表示，并结合实际运行时测量，迭代诊断性能回退和调整编译选项。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整平台、benchmark 和提升幅度。可确认的是它以运行时延迟为反馈，和把编译器当黑盒的自动调优方案形成对比，并强调可迁移到新 benchmark 和硬件平台。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of using LLMs for compiler performance tuning under complex microarchitectural effects, noisy runtime measurements, and hidden compiler-internal states.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent method for compiler optimization. It does not advance foundation pretraining, but it offers a relatively clean tool-use setting where the LLM reads compiler evidence rather than merely emitting code or flags.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoPass is an inference-only, training-free multi-agent framework. It lets LLMs query compiler-internal optimization states, inspect intermediate representations, and use measured runtime feedback to diagnose regressions and iteratively refine optimization configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full platform details, benchmarks, or exact gains. It states that AutoPass is evaluated through runtime feedback and contrasted with black-box auto-tuning schemes, with emphasis on portability to new benchmarks and platforms.

recommendation.zh: 看系统接口设计即可；把编译器状态暴露给 LLM 比纯 prompt 搜索更靠谱，但这是工具闭环，不是训练范式。
recommendation.en: Read the system-interface design only; exposing compiler state to the LLM is cleaner than prompt-only search, but this is a tool loop, not a training paradigm.

paper.title: AgentArmor: A Framework, Evaluation, \& Mitigation of Coding Agent Failures
paper.abstract: Software engineering and deployment are increasingly being delegated to AI coding agents. The scale of their adoption is surfacing rare, but highly destructive, failure modes. In this paper, we study these failure modes as stemming from three distinct mechanisms: underspecification, where default model behavior is unsafe; capability errors, where the safe action is available but the model does not adhere to it due to bias or capability limitations; and agent harness errors, where the model fails

summary.core_problem: 随着 AI 编程智能体越来越多地接管软件工程任务，它们在非对抗场景下暴露出罕见但破坏性极强的失效模式，现有评测缺乏对这些关键安全漏洞的系统性评估。
summary.importance: 本文系统梳理了编程智能体在实际部署中的失效机制，并提出了针对性的评测基准和缓解策略，对提升智能体框架的安全性和可靠性有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将智能体失效分解为三个连续阶段：目标设定不足（默认行为不安全）、能力缺陷（无法或不愿遵循安全规范）和框架执行错误（无法通过框架正确执行）。基于此，构建了包含 20 个编程环境和 59 个合成对话模板的评测集。为缓解这些问题，提出了 AgentArmor 框架改进方案，包括：轻量级命令分类器（防止目标偏移）、确定性护栏（如删除前强制执行 `ls -la`）、以及允许智能体修改自身框架的新工具（如设置文件不可变、选择性缓存历史记录以减少上下文冗余）。
summary.experiments: 在 Claude Opus 4.6、GPT 5.4 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 上进行了评测，每个场景采样超过 500 次。结果表明，当任务描述不明确时，模型倾向于以牺牲安全性为代价完成任务。AgentArmor 在统计显著性上提升了安全性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Section 3 的失效模式分类（M1-M3）和 Section 5 中 AgentArmor 的具体设计，特别是允许智能体修改自身框架的创新思路。

summary_en.core_problem: As AI coding agents increasingly take over software engineering tasks, they exhibit rare but highly destructive failure modes in non-adversarial scenarios, which are not systematically evaluated by existing benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: This paper systematically categorizes the failure mechanisms of coding agents in real-world deployments and proposes targeted evaluation benchmarks and mitigation strategies, providing direct reference value for improving the safety and reliability of agent frameworks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose agent failures into three sequential stages: underspecification (unsafe default behavior), capability errors (inability or unwillingness to follow safe specifications), and harness execution errors (failure to execute correctly through the harness). Based on this, they construct an evaluation set comprising 20 coding environments and 59 synthetic transcript templates. To mitigate these issues, they propose AgentArmor, a set of harness improvements including a lightweight command classifier (to prevent goal drift), deterministic guardrails (e.g., forcing `ls -la` before deletion), and novel tools allowing the agent to modify its own harness (e.g., making files immutable, selectively caching history to reduce context bloat).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations were conducted on Claude Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, and Gemini 3.1 Pro, with over 500 samples per scenario. Results show that when tasks are underspecified, models tend to complete the task at the expense of safety. AgentArmor significantly improves safety with statistical significance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the categorization of failure modes (M1-M3) and Section 5 for the specific design of AgentArmor, especially the innovative idea of allowing agents to modify their own harness.

recommendation.zh: 对 Coding Agent 的失败模式做了很好的 Taxonomy（特别是把模型能力错误和 Harness 错误区分开），提出的缓解策略偏工程，做 Agent 系统的同学值得一读。
recommendation.en: Provides a good taxonomy of coding agent failure modes (especially distinguishing model capability errors from harness errors); the proposed mitigation strategies are engineering-oriented, worth reading for those building agent systems.

paper.title: Probe-and-Refine Tuning of Repository Guidance for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: LLM-based coding agents need higher-level operational knowledge about a repository (which files house which subsystems, how to run the test suite, which workflows have historically led to wrong fixes) that does not exist in the code itself. Engineers typically maintain \texttt{AGENTS.md} files to supply this context as instructions for coding agents, but whether they help is contested: recent studies disagree on whether LLM-generated guidance improves or harms agent performance. In this paper we

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM编码代理的仓库指导文档（如AGENTS.md）效果存在争议、静态知识库适配性差的问题
summary.importance: 编码代理方向的方法创新，首次提出基于合成bug探针的指导文档迭代调优范式，解释了此前研究结论冲突的核心原因
summary.technical_approach: 提出probe-and-refine调优流程，用合成bug修复探针任务，通过单次LLM调用迭代诊断并修补仓库指导文件，调优过程无需代理循环或工具调用
summary.experiments: 在SWE-bench Verified基准上，用Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（200步）做4次独立试验，平均解决率33.0%，优于初始静态知识库基线的28.3%

summary_en.core_problem: Resolves conflicting findings on whether repository guidance files (e.g., AGENTS.md) improve coding agent performance, and addresses poor adaptability of static knowledge bases
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation in coding agents; first proposes iterative tuning of repository guidance via synthetic bug probes, explaining the root cause of conflicting prior results
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces probe-and-refine tuning: uses synthetic bug-fix probe tasks to iteratively diagnose and patch guidance files via single-shot LLM calls, with no agent loop or tool use during tuning
summary_en.experiments: On SWE-bench Verified with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (200 steps) across 4 independent trials, achieves 33.0% mean resolve rate, outperforming the initial static knowledge base baseline of 28.3%

recommendation.zh: 编码代理的小粒度方法改进，核心是仓库指导文档自动调优，与预训练核心关联弱，仅作agent方向文献备查
recommendation.en: Fine-grained improvement for coding agents focusing on auto-tuning repo guidance, weakly related to core pretraining, only for coding agent literature reference

paper.title: Phoenix: Safe GitHub Issue Resolution via Multi-Agent LLMs
paper.abstract: We present Phoenix, a multi-agent LLM system that resolves GitHub issues from triage through pull-request creation, combining seven layered safety controls with a baseline-aware test evaluation strategy. Phoenix decomposes the work across six specialized agents. Planner, reproducer, coder, tester, failure analyst and Pull Request (PR) agent, all coordinated by a label-based GitHub webhook state machine. Every change is checked against a baseline test run before a pull request is opened. On a 24-

summary.core_problem: 现有GitHub问题自动解决系统缺乏安全控制，易引入代码回归，需端到端安全的多Agent解决方案。
summary.importance: 工程系统类贡献，提出7层安全控制+基线感知测试策略，保障代码修改的正确性无回归。
summary.technical_approach: 拆分6个专用Agent（规划/复现/编码/测试/故障分析/PR），由基于GitHub webhook的标签状态机协调，每步变更与基线测试结果比对后才提交PR。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-bench Lite的24条curated切片上oracle解决率75%，成功运行无pass-to-pass回归（作者明确说明该切片不可直接与全榜单对比）；42个真实仓库问题上100%正确性保留。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated GitHub issue resolution systems lack safety controls and easily introduce code regressions, requiring an end-to-end secure multi-agent solution.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system contribution, proposes 7-layer safety controls and a baseline-aware test evaluation strategy to ensure zero regression in code modifications.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes work into 6 specialized agents (planner/reproducer/coder/tester/failure analyst/PR agent) coordinated by a label-based GitHub webhook state machine; all changes are checked against baseline test runs before PR creation.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 75% oracle resolution rate on a 24-instance curated SWE-bench Lite slice with no pass-to-pass regressions (authors explicitly state the slice is not comparable to full leaderboard); 100% correctness preservation on 42 real repository issues.

recommendation.zh: 编码Agent的工程实现参考，7层安全控制模块设计有少量借鉴价值，看§3的安全机制部分即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering reference for coding agents, minor value in the 7-layer safety control design; read §3 safety mechanism section only.

paper.title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
paper.abstract: Achieving dexterous robotic manipulation in the real world heavily relies on human supervision and algorithm engineering, which becomes a central bottleneck in the pursuit of general physical intelligence. Although emerging coding agents can generate code to automate algorithm search, their successes remain largely confined in digital environments. We conjecture that the missing abstraction to automate robotics research is a repeatable feedback loop for real-world policy improvement: reset the s

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 难以在真实机器人环境中闭环改进操作策略的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent harness 和真实世界自改进系统。它把代码生成 agent 从数字环境推向物理实验闭环，对通用 agent 的自动化研究流程有旁路启发，但与 LLM 基座预训练关系间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ENPIRE，一个面向 coding agent 的真实机器人策略改进框架。核心闭环是 reset scene、execute policy、verify outcome、refine next iteration。系统包含 Environment 模块用于自动 reset 和验证，Policy Improvement 模块用于策略改进，Rollout 模块用于单机器人或多机器人并行评估，Evolution 模块让 coding agent 迭代策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出机器人任务数量、策略类型、coding agent 模型、基线或成功率提升。可确认的是系统支持真实世界 rollout 和多机器人并行评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of using coding agents to iteratively improve robot manipulation policies in the real world.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent harness and real-world self-improvement loop. It extends coding-agent automation from digital environments to physical policy iteration, which is indirectly relevant to general agent training but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ENPIRE instantiates a loop of scene reset, policy execution, outcome verification, and next-iteration refinement. It includes an Environment module for reset and verification, a Policy Improvement module, a Rollout module for one or multiple physical robots, and an Evolution module where coding agents iterate on policies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the number of robot tasks, policy classes, coding-agent models, baselines, or success-rate gains. It does state that the system supports real-world rollouts and parallel evaluation with multiple robots.

recommendation.zh: 物理闭环的 harness 思路可借鉴，但机器人变量太多；只看系统分解，别把结果外推到通用 agent RL。
recommendation.en: The physical feedback harness is worth noting, but robotics confounds are heavy; read the system decomposition, not the generalization claims.

paper.title: SWE-Future: Forecast-Conditioned Data Synthesis for Future-Oriented Software Engineering Agents
paper.abstract: Realistic coding-agent benchmarks often replay public GitHub issues and pull requests, making them vulnerable to overlap with model pretraining, fine-tuning, synthetic-data generation, or benchmark-driven model selection. Fully synthetic tasks avoid direct historical replay, but can drift away from real repository needs. We propose SWE-Future, a forecast-conditioned data synthesis method for future-oriented coding tasks. Given a forecast snapshot at time $T_0$, the method uses only pre-$T_0$ rep

summary.core_problem: 现有代码Agent基准要么直接回放历史GitHub PR，存在和预训练/微调/合成数据管线的污染风险，要么使用完全合成的任务，脱离真实仓库的实际开发优先级与约束，缺少同时保证任务真实性、无信息泄漏、符合仓库真实演进方向的代码任务构造方法。
summary.importance: 该工作解决了代码类训练数据与评测基准的污染难题，其时间隔离、预测驱动的合成思路对构造无泄漏的代码SFT/RL训练数据、干净的代码Agent评测集有直接实用价值，任务族预测的逻辑也可迁移到其他快速演进领域的训练/评测数据构造。
summary.technical_approach: 提出预测条件式数据合成框架SWE-Future，设置三个严格的时间节点实现信息隔离：1）预测快照T0：仅使用T0之前的仓库证据（issue、PR、标签、代码文本）预测未来的任务族，覆盖功能新增/增强、bug修复、重构三类开发活动，不预测具体的未来PR；2）回溯验证窗口(T0, T1]：冻结预测结果后，仅使用T0到T1之间的PR元数据验证预测的任务族是否匹配真实未来开发方向，丢弃未通过验证的任务族；3）任务生成快照Tgen：以验证通过的任务族为条件，基于Tgen时刻的仓库状态合成具体编码任务，再经过目标测试构造、泄漏检查、FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS校验过滤不合格任务。
summary.experiments: 在80个Python生态仓库上开展回溯验证，任务族预测的未来工作相关性在主语义匹配指标下达到58.1%；最终构造了覆盖61个仓库、包含200个可执行验证任务的代码Agent数据集，所有任务严格遵守信息边界，不存在历史PR回放带来的数据污染问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注方法部分的时间边界设计（图2）、选择任务族而非具体PR作为预测单元的设计逻辑、最终的任务校验过滤流程，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding agent benchmarks either replay historical GitHub pull requests, which carries non-trivial data contamination risk for pretraining, fine-tuning, and synthetic data pipelines, or use fully synthetic tasks that drift away from real development priorities and constraints of production repositories. No prior approach balances task realism, strict leakage prevention, and alignment with actual repository evolution trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses the growing contamination problem in coding post-training datasets and evaluation benchmarks. Its time-isolated, forecast-driven synthesis design provides a practical template for building uncontaminated SFT/RL training data and clean coding agent test sets, and the task family prediction logic can generalize to data construction for other fast-evolving domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Future implements a forecast-conditioned synthesis pipeline with three strict temporal cutoffs to enforce information boundaries: 1) Forecast snapshot T0: Only pre-T0 repository evidence (issues, PRs, labels, codebase text) is used to predict future task families covering feature additions/enhancements, bug fixes, and refactoring work, without forecasting exact future PRs. 2) Retrospective validation window (T0, T1]: Predictions are frozen, and post-T0 PR metadata is only used to check whether predicted families match actual future development activity, with unvalidated families discarded. 3) Task generation snapshot Tgen: Validated task families are used as conditioning signals to generate concrete coding tasks from the Tgen repository state, followed by a filtering pipeline including target test construction, leakage checks, and FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS validation.
summary_en.experiments: Retrospective evaluation across 80 Python ecosystem repositories shows the forecaster achieves 58.1% future work relevance under the primary semantic matching metric. The final released dataset contains 200 executable coding tasks across 61 repositories, all constructed with strict information controls to eliminate contamination from historical PR replay.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on the temporal boundary design (Figure 2), the rationale for using task families instead of exact PRs as the forecast unit, and the final task validation pipeline. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和污染控制 setup；58.1% 相关性不高，但时间截断评测协议比又一批 GitHub replay 更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the method and contamination-control setup; 58.1% relevance is modest, but the temporal-cutoff protocol is cleaner than another GitHub replay benchmark.

paper.title: Code-Augur: Agentic Vulnerability Detection via Specification Inference
paper.abstract: The advent of agentic vulnerability detection is already becoming a watershed moment for software security. Audits conducted entirely by autonomous LLM agents are uncovering critical vulnerabilities in fundamental software underpinning digital society. Many of these vulnerabilities remained masked for years, surfacing only now with AI agents. Yet the reasoning behind these discoveries remains alarmingly opaque and unvalidated. What assumptions did the agent make about a function's inputs when it

summary.core_problem: 让 LLM 安全审计 Agent 在检测漏洞时显式暴露其关于函数输入和安全条件的隐含假设，并用运行时反例持续修正这些假设。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding/security agent 方法改进：把漏洞检测从直接给结论转为先推断安全规格、再用 falsification 校验。它对通用预训练关系较远，但对代码 Agent 的可验证推理和训练信号设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Code-Augur，一个面向 agentic vulnerability detection 的执行框架。流程包括分析代码库、推断安全规格、把 Agent 的 tacit assumptions 外显成可检查条件，并通过运行时 falsification 迭代 refine 这些规格；这是对现有 LLM Agent 审计流程的结构化约束，而非新基座模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验规模、benchmark、baseline 或提升幅度；只说明目标是提高 agentic 漏洞分析的可解释性、可验证性和漏报风险控制。
summary.authors_note: Abhik Roychoudhury 是软件工程、程序分析和自动化调试方向的知名研究者；给定摘要未提供完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to make LLM-based vulnerability-detection agents expose their implicit assumptions about inputs and security conditions, then refine those assumptions through runtime falsification.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding/security-agent method contribution: it moves agentic auditing from direct vulnerability claims toward specification inference plus falsification. It is distant from pretraining, but relevant to verifiable reasoning and training-signal design for code agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Code-Augur is a harness for agentic vulnerability detection. It analyzes a codebase, infers security specifications, externalizes the agent’s tacit assumptions as checkable conditions, and continuously refines them via runtime falsification. The contribution is a structured agent workflow, not a new foundation model.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report full experimental scale, benchmark details, baselines, or numerical gains. It frames the work around explainability, validation, and reducing missed vulnerabilities in agentic analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: Abhik Roychoudhury is a well-known researcher in software engineering, program analysis, and automated debugging. Full institutional affiliations are not available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；看 specification inference 与 falsification 流程即可，适合作为代码 Agent 训练信号设计的弱参考。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; inspect the specification-inference and falsification loop as a weak signal for code-agent supervision design.

paper.title: OpenAnt: LLM-Powered Vulnerability Discovery Through Code Decomposition, Adversarial Verification, and Dynamic Testing
paper.abstract: Automated vulnerability discovery in large codebases remains challenging: traditional static analysis produces high false-positive rates, while dynamic approaches such as fuzzing require substantial infrastructure and often target narrow classes of bugs. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable semantic reasoning about program behavior, but applying LLMs to repository-scale security analysis introduces challenges related to context management, cost, and verification.   We present O

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在大规模代码库漏洞发现中上下文过长、成本高、误报多和缺少可执行验证的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码安全 Agent 系统。它不是代码模型预训练或 SWE benchmark，但把静态分析、LLM 语义推理、对抗式验证和动态测试串成 repo-scale pipeline，对构建实用 coding agent 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: OpenAnt 先用静态程序分析把代码库拆成可独立分析的单元，并按外部入口可达性过滤；随后让候选漏洞经过受约束的攻击者模拟做对抗式验证；最后结合动态测试降低误报。方法重点是把 LLM 放在多阶段验证链中，而不是让模型一次性阅读整个仓库。
summary.experiments: 摘要称可达性过滤最多减少 97% 的分析面，同时保留攻击相关代码。摘要未给出使用的具体 LLM、代码库数量、漏洞类别覆盖、与静态分析器或 fuzzing 的定量误报/召回对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets repository-scale vulnerability discovery with LLMs, where context management, inference cost, false positives, and lack of executable verification are the main bottlenecks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a code-security agent system. It is not about code-model pretraining or a SWE benchmark, but its pipeline combining static analysis, LLM reasoning, adversarial verification, and dynamic testing is relevant to practical coding-agent design.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenAnt decomposes a codebase into self-contained analysis units and filters them by reachability from external entry points. Candidate vulnerabilities are then checked through constrained attacker simulation and dynamic testing, putting the LLM inside a staged verification loop instead of asking it to reason over a whole repository at once.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that reachability filtering can reduce the analysis surface by up to 97% while preserving attack-relevant code. It does not specify the LLM used, number of repositories, vulnerability classes, or quantitative precision/recall comparisons against static analyzers or fuzzers.

recommendation.zh: 只看 pipeline 设计即可；97% surface reduction 有工程味，但缺少公开定量细节，别当模型能力结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the pipeline only; the 97% surface reduction is useful engineering, but the abstract lacks enough quantitative detail to infer model capability.

paper.title: GameCraft-Bench: Can Agents Build Playable Games End-to-End in a Real Game Engine?
paper.abstract: Game generation is an emerging application of coding agents, requiring models to transform natural-language specifications into playable interactive systems. Unlike traditional coding tasks, game generation takes place within a game engine, where scripts, scenes, assets, rendering, and runtime interactions must jointly produce coherent gameplay. We formalize end-to-end game generation as the problem of producing a complete game artifact that realizes a specification through observable player-gam

summary.core_problem: 如何评测“端到端游戏生成”这种 coding agent 任务：模型不仅要写脚本，还要在真实引擎里产出可启动、可交互、可验证的完整工程，并且评测要能通过交互行为而不是静态代码检查来判断是否满足规格。
summary.importance: 这是典型 eval 资产，对预训练/训练动态的直接信息增益有限。它更像是给 coding agent 与工具使用系统提供一个更贴近真实开发的评测合同（engine grounding、artifact completeness、interactive verification）。如果研究重点是通用 LLM 预训练、数据配比、tokenizer、scaling law，这篇的优先级不高；但如果团队在做 code agent 的中后期训练（tool-use、执行反馈、长程任务），它能提供更“系统级”的失败模式分解与可复现评测框架。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 GameCraft-Bench：
- 环境：真实游戏引擎 Godot，要求 agent 在引擎原生工程结构/文档/资源约束下开发（Engine Grounding）。
- 输出：必须交付完整可启动的游戏工程，而不是局部补丁或单文件脚本（Artifact Completeness）。
- 评测：通过回放式交互（replayed demonstrations）验证游戏在玩家输入下的可玩性与行为一致性，而非仅靠静态单测或代码审查（Interactive Verification）。

基准包含 140 个任务、15 个 game families，并用 rubric 从机制、内容深度、视觉功能、呈现质量等维度做诊断。
summary.experiments: 作者评测多种前沿 coding agents，最强系统总体得分 41.46%，其余显著更低；失败不集中在单一能力，而是分散在核心机制实现、内容完整度、视觉反馈与美术呈现等多个环节，并且不同 game family 差异很大。给定片段未包含更细的 per-family/per-metric 表格与具体 agent 名单，需要在实验章节核对可复现细节（运行配置、交互轨迹数量、rubric 打分一致性）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
1）先读“desiderata”定义与 Table/Figure（解释为什么现有 benchmark 不满足三要素）。
2）快速看任务构成：15 个 families 各自考什么能力、规格描述粒度如何。
3）重点看评测协议：replay 交互如何生成、如何避免评测侧探索带来的不确定性、rubric 如何落地。
4）最后看诊断分析：哪些失败模式最常见，哪些更像工具链/工程管理问题而不是代码生成本身。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate end-to-end game generation by coding agents in a way that reflects real development: the agent must produce a complete, launchable game project in a real engine, and correctness should be judged via interactive behavior rather than static code inspection.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation asset. It has limited direct impact on core LLM pretraining topics (data/optimizer/scaling/tokenizer), but it is relevant if you work on code agents and post-training for tool use, execution feedback, and long-horizon project construction. The main value is a clearer benchmark contract and more diagnostic failure decomposition than typical code-only benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GameCraft-Bench is built around three desiderata:
- Engine Grounding: development happens in a real engine (Godot) with native docs/assets.
- Artifact Completeness: the output must be a full, runnable game project, not partial edits.
- Interactive Verification: evaluation is based on executable gameplay evidence via replayed interaction traces, complemented by rubric-based scoring over mechanics, content depth, visual functionality, and presentation.

The benchmark includes 140 tasks across 15 game families, aiming to cover diverse gameplay requirements and system components.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarking multiple frontier coding agents shows the best system reaches 41.46% overall, with most agents substantially lower. Errors are distributed across mechanics, content completeness, visual feedback, and presentation, and performance varies sharply by game family. The provided excerpt does not include detailed per-metric tables or full reproducibility specs; those need to be checked in the experiments section (runtime setup, replay protocol details, scoring reliability).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Read the three desiderata and the comparison table/figures explaining why prior benchmarks fall short.
2) Skim task taxonomy: what each of the 15 families tests and how specs are written.
3) Focus on the evaluation protocol: how replay traces are constructed, how interaction verification avoids evaluator-side exploration variance, and how the rubric is operationalized.
4) End with the diagnostic analysis to understand dominant failure modes and whether they stem from coding, tooling, or project-level coordination.

recommendation.zh: 读任务定义和评价协议即可；它把 coding agent 评测从代码正确性推到可执行 artifact。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and evaluation protocol; it pushes coding-agent evaluation from code correctness toward executable artifacts.

paper.title: Position: Coding Benchmarks Are Misaligned with Agentic Software Engineering
paper.abstract: Coding agents have become a major mode of software engineering, but the benchmarks we use to compare them were designed in a pre-agent era: they collapse model, harness, and environment into a single end-to-end score, typically computed against one reference solution, with no component-level signal for iteration. We argue that current coding benchmarks are misaligned with agentic software engineering. A coding agent in practice is not a model: it is a system harness -- a composite of models, har

summary.core_problem: 这篇 position paper 的核心问题是：现有 coding benchmark 仍在评估“单个模型一次性生成代码”的能力，但实际 coding agent 是模型、prompt、工具、环境、上下文和反馈信号组成的系统。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对代码模型和 agent 评测有启发。它提醒研究者不要把 SWE-Bench、HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、BigCodeBench 这类端到端分数简单归因于 base model 或 post-train 方法。对于训练代码模型，benchmark signal 的归因错误会反过来影响数据构造、RL 环境设计和 verifier 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 论文没有提出新模型，而是重新定义 coding agent 的评测对象。作者区分 agent harness 和 system harness：前者是单个模型在工具循环中解决任务，后者负责把高层目标拆成任务、调度一个或多个 agent、管理仓库和运行环境、组织上下文、收集反馈。系统被分解为五个组件：tasks、agent harnesses、environment、context、feedback signals。反馈又按时延和可信度分为 inner-loop、middle-loop、outer-loop。inner-loop 包括测试、类型检查、lint、编译；middle-loop 包括代码审查、仿真、维护性检查；outer-loop 包括 PR 接受率、revert、事故和用户反馈。作者认为更合理的 coding benchmark 应该给出组件级信号，使用独立行为规格而不是单一参考答案，并显式度量系统在迭代和反馈中的表现。
summary.experiments: 这不是一篇实验论文，没有受控实验或标准 benchmark 结果。证据主要来自对现有 coding benchmark 的结构性分析，以及作者开源的 NS2 系统 harness 经验。NS2 使用 issue 作为协调单位，运行包含工具调用的 agent loop，并引入严格 verifier、middle-loop review、outer-loop friction/revert 信号。论文的关键观察是：harness、环境、上下文和反馈设计带来的分数变化，可能接近相邻模型代际之间的差距，因此单一端到端分数不足以支持模型能力归因。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–20 分钟。重点看 The System Harnesses 一节，里面对 agent harness、system harness、五个组件和三层反馈的拆分最有用。Three Symptoms of the Misalignment 一节可快速扫读，主要抓住三点：模型与 harness 混淆、单一参考答案不适合真实软件工程、缺少迭代过程和组件级信号。对做代码模型训练或 RL 环境的人，最值得带走的是 verifier 和 feedback signal 的分层，而不是具体的 NS2 实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that current coding benchmarks evaluate an older object of study: a model producing code in a mostly fixed harness. Real coding agents are composite systems made of models, prompts, tools, environments, context management, and feedback loops.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not directly about pretraining, but it matters for code-model evaluation and agentic RL setups. It warns against attributing an end-to-end SWE-Bench-style score to the base model alone. Harness design, environment setup, context construction, and verifier quality can move scores by margins comparable to model-generation differences. For code model training, this affects how evaluation signals are interpreted and how synthetic tasks, verifiers, and feedback loops should be designed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is a benchmark-position argument rather than a new algorithm. The paper separates an agent harness from a system harness. An agent harness is a model in a tool-use loop for a single task. A system harness sits outside it: it converts higher-level goals into tasks, dispatches one or more agent harnesses, manages the repository and runtime environment, curates context, and routes feedback. The system is decomposed into five parts: tasks, agent harnesses, environment, context, and feedback signals. Feedback is further divided into inner-loop signals such as tests, type checks, linting, and compilation; middle-loop signals such as review, simulation, and maintainability checks; and outer-loop signals such as PR acceptance, reverts, incidents, and user outcomes. The proposed benchmark direction is to expose component-level measurements and grade against independent behavioral specifications rather than a single reference solution.
summary_en.experiments: There are no controlled experiments or new benchmark numbers. The evidence is an analysis of existing coding benchmarks and practical observations from NS2, an open-source issue-driven system harness described by the authors. NS2 uses deterministic checks and agent-arbitrated checks, including strict verifiers, middle-loop review, and outer-loop friction or revert signals. The main empirical claim is qualitative: changes in harness, context, environment, and feedback can produce score movements large enough to confound model comparisons.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time is about 15–20 minutes. The most useful part is the system-harness section, especially the distinction between agent harness and system harness, the five-component decomposition, and the three-tier feedback taxonomy. The misalignment section can be read for the three main failure modes: conflating model and harness, grading against a single reference solution, and losing iteration-level or component-level signal. For researchers working on code-model post-training or RL environments, the feedback taxonomy is the main reusable idea.

recommendation.zh: 对理解 SWE-bench 类分数有帮助，但偏立场文章；直接读三个症状和结论即可，别期待方法。
recommendation.en: Useful framing for interpreting coding-agent leaderboards, but it is a position piece; read the three symptoms and stop.

paper.title: All Smoke, No Alarm: Oracle Signals in Agent-Authored Test Code
paper.abstract: Software practitioners increasingly use AI coding agents that generate test code alongside production code in open source pull requests (PRs). Recent studies report more than 932,000 agent-authored PRs across more than 116,000 repositories, yet whether their test files contain meaningful verification logic remains underexplored. Test files lacking explicit assertions execute code without verifying behavior, so quality gates based on test-file presence overestimate verification strength. The goal

summary.core_problem: AI编码agent生成的测试代码常缺少有意义的验证逻辑（oracle signals），导致基于'测试文件存在与否'的质量门控高估了实际验证强度
summary.importance: 实证研究贡献：首次大规模系统分析agent生成测试代码的验证质量
summary.technical_approach: 对86156个测试文件补丁（来自5个coding agent：Codex、Copilot、Devin、Cursor、Claude Code）进行定性+定量分析，构建8种oracle signal的句法分类法，关联合并结果和评审工作量
summary.experiments: 33596个PR，2807个GitHub仓库，384个分层样本的定性分析

summary_en.core_problem: AI coding agents generate test code that often lacks meaningful verification logic (oracle signals), so quality gates based on test-file presence overestimate actual verification strength
summary_en.importance: Empirical analysis contribution: first large-scale systematic study of verification quality in agent-authored test code
summary_en.technical_approach: Qualitative + quantitative analysis of 86,156 test-file patches from 5 coding agents (Codex, Copilot, Devin, Cursor, Claude Code); develops a syntactic taxonomy of 8 oracle signal types; correlates with merge outcomes and review effort
summary_en.experiments: 33,596 PRs across 2,807 GitHub repositories; qualitative analysis of 384 stratified samples

recommendation.zh: 软件工程领域的实证分析，揭示coding agent生成测试代码的质量问题，对预训练研究无直接启发，glance即可
recommendation.en: Empirical software engineering study revealing test-code quality issues in coding agent output; no direct pretraining insight; glance only

paper.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona
paper.abstract: OpenAI plans to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments, enabling long-running AI agents across enterprise workflows.

summary.core_problem: OpenAI 宣布计划收购 Ona，用于扩展 Codex 的安全、持久云环境，支持更长时间运行的企业级 AI agent 工作流。

summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 发布的收购公告；涉及 OpenAI 和 Ona，未给出具体研究作者。

summary_en.core_problem: OpenAI announces its plan to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments for long-running enterprise agent workflows.
summary_en.importance: This is an industry event rather than a research paper. Its relevance comes from the shift of Codex toward stateful execution environments for longer software-engineering tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The post only states the intended direction: integrating secure, persistent cloud environments into Codex so agents can maintain state and run longer tasks. It does not disclose sandboxing, permissioning, state management, scheduling, or evaluation protocols.
summary_en.experiments: No model scale, training data, baselines, SWE-style evaluation results, long-horizon success rates, or system metrics are reported.
summary_en.authors_note: Published by OpenAI Research as an acquisition announcement involving OpenAI and Ona; no individual research authors are specified.

recommendation.zh: 技术内容很薄，但收购指向清楚：coding agent 的瓶颈正转向持久环境、权限和长任务执行。
recommendation.en: Technically thin, but the signal is clear: coding-agent bottlenecks are moving toward persistent environments, permissions, and long-running execution.

paper.title: Can LLM Coding Agents Reason About Time Series?
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used for automated decision-making systems in finance, healthcare, or environmental monitoring. Time series data are ubiquitous in these fields, yet hard to process automatically. Can time series be analyzed by LLM agents? We examine three approaches: providing the agent with raw numerical data, using the LLM as a coding agent, or a combination of both. In the coding agent setup, the model iteratively queries the data using Python code. Using t

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM coding agents 是否能通过原始数值输入、Python 工具调用或二者结合来理解和分析时间序列。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 能力分析。主题偏领域评测，不是通用预训练研究；但它暴露了工具型 agent 在数值统计任务中的边界，对训练数据中代码执行、统计推理和工具监督信号的设计有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 比较三种设置：直接把原始时间序列数值提供给模型；让模型作为 coding agent 迭代编写 Python 查询数据；以及同时提供原始数据和代码访问。作者还用强 LLM judge 分析输出，定位模型策略和推理缺口。
summary.experiments: 在两个时间序列理解 benchmark 上评测。coding-agent 设置相比只处理原始数据的模型最高提升约 10%，但最强 agent 仍有约 22-34% 问题答错。分析显示模型能选择合适统计检验，但常漏掉关键细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Charles University 的 Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM coding agents can reason over time series using raw numerical input, Python-based data querying, or a combination of both.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical coding-agent capability study. It is domain-leaning rather than a general pretraining paper, but it gives a useful failure profile for tool-using agents on numerical and statistical reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare three setups: feeding raw numerical data to the model, using the model as a coding agent that iteratively queries data with Python, and combining raw data access with code access. A strong LLM judge is used to analyze model strategies and reasoning gaps.
summary_en.experiments: On two time-series understanding benchmarks, code-access agents outperform raw-data-only models by up to 10%. Even the best agent still answers roughly 22-34% of questions incorrectly; the analysis suggests agents can choose statistical tests but often miss important nuances.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics at Charles University.

recommendation.zh: 看实验结论即可；它提醒代码执行不是数值推理的充分条件，22-34% 错误率比提升幅度更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the empirical result only; it shows code execution is not enough for numerical reasoning, and the 22-34% error rate matters more than the gain.

institutions: Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics, Charles University
Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics

paper.title: daVinci-kernel: Co-Evolving Skill Selection, Summarization, and Utilization via RL for GPU Kernel Optimization
paper.abstract: GPU kernel optimization represents a paradigm where functional correctness is assumed and execution efficiency is the objective. We present daVinci-kernel, a reinforcement learning framework that couples skill discovery with skill exploitation through a dynamically evolving skill library. daVinci-kernel jointly trains three agents sharing one LLM backbone: a Skill Selection Agent that retrieves relevant techniques via BM25 and LLM reranking, a Policy Agent that generates multi-turn CUDA/Triton k

summary.core_problem: 解决GPU kernel优化中，现有LLM方法难以同时实现技能发现、复用与高效生成的问题
summary.importance: 属于系统方法创新，提出共享LLM backbone的三Agent RL框架，实现技能库的动态演化与复用，提升GPU kernel生成的效率与性能
summary.technical_approach: 提出daVinci-kernel框架，包含三个共享同一LLM backbone的Agent：1）技能选择Agent（BM25检索+LLM重排相关优化技巧）；2）策略Agent（基于选中技能生成多轮CUDA/Triton kernel）；3）技能总结Agent（将成功rollout蒸馏为可复用技能）；采用结构化SFT冷启动，后用多轮REINFORCE+ per-agent优势估计端到端联合训练，技能仅在执行验证有可复现加速时加入库
summary.experiments: 在KernelBench基准上测试，14B参数的daVinci-kernel-14B模型取得37.2%的加速提升（摘要未披露完整指标与基线细节）

summary_en.core_problem: Resolves the difficulty of existing LLM methods for GPU kernel optimization to simultaneously achieve skill discovery, reuse, and efficient generation
summary_en.importance: System and methodological innovation; proposes a three-agent RL framework with a shared LLM backbone, enabling dynamic evolution and reuse of a skill library to improve the efficiency and performance of GPU kernel generation
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the daVinci-kernel framework with three agents sharing one LLM backbone: 1) Skill Selection Agent (BM25 retrieval + LLM reranking of optimization techniques), 2) Policy Agent (generates multi-turn CUDA/Triton kernels conditioned on selected skills), 3) Skill Summary Agent (distills successful rollouts into reusable skills); uses structured SFT for cold start, then jointly trains end-to-end via multi-turn REINFORCE with per-agent advantage estimation, adding skills to the library only after execution verification confirms reproducible speedups
summary_en.experiments: Tested on the KernelBench benchmark; the 14B-parameter daVinci-kernel-14B achieves 37.2% speedup (full metrics and baseline details not disclosed in abstract)

recommendation.zh: 代码Agent做GPU kernel优化的工程实现，对基座预训练无直接启发，仅作为多Agent协同设计案例备查
recommendation.en: Engineering implementation of coding agent for GPU kernel optimization; no direct insight for foundation pretraining, keep as multi-agent collaboration reference only

paper.title: AIChilles: Automatically Uncovering Hidden Weaknesses in AI-Evolved Systems
paper.abstract: The computer systems community has recently seen growing interest in AI-driven system evolution, where AI agents iteratively rewrite systems. Frameworks such as AdaEvolve and Engram report 12-60% score improvements over human-designed algorithms. While these results are promising, there are practical concerns if these AI-evolved programs can perform worse on unseen workloads and exhibit scalability regressions. Given the speed and scale of AI-generated code, we need automated mechanisms to uncov

summary.core_problem: 自动发现 AI-evolved systems programs 在未见工作负载上的隐藏退化，包括正确性、运行时间、内存使用和输出质量问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 AI 生成/演化代码的鲁棒性测试系统。它不属于预训练，但对 coding agent 和自动程序优化很实用：平均 benchmark 分数提升可能掩盖长尾 workload regression。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AIChilles，输入人工基线程序 P 和 AI 演化程序 P'，搜索使 P' 相对 P 退化的合法工作负载。方法组合了确定性的 workload-parameter extraction、agent-based constraint inference，以及面向不同系统应用和缺陷类型的差分搜索。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到 AdaEvolve 和 Engram 报告过 12-60% 的分数提升，并以此作为问题背景。AIChilles 的具体测试对象、发现的退化数量、搜索成本和误报率未在摘要中给出，需要正文确认。
summary.authors_note: Vyas Sekar 是系统与网络安全方向知名研究者；摘要未给出完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to automatically uncover hidden regressions in AI-evolved systems programs on unseen workloads, including correctness, runtime, memory, and output-quality failures.
summary_en.importance: This is a robustness-testing system for AI-generated or AI-evolved code. It is not a pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to coding agents and automated program optimization because average benchmark gains can hide long-tail workload regressions.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes AIChilles, which takes a baseline program P and an AI-evolved program P' and searches for valid workloads where P' regresses relative to P. It combines deterministic workload-parameter extraction, agent-based constraint inference, and differential search across weakness types.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract cites AdaEvolve and Engram as reporting 12-60% score improvements, motivating the need for regression search. It does not provide the number of systems tested, regressions found, search cost, or false-positive rate.
summary_en.authors_note: Vyas Sekar is a well-known researcher in systems and network security; the supplied abstract does not provide full affiliation details.

recommendation.zh: 结论对 code agent 可靠性有用；只看 workload 搜索设计，别把它当模型能力论文。
recommendation.en: Useful for code-agent reliability; read the workload-search design, not as a model-capability paper.

paper.title: Dialogue SWE-Bench: A Benchmark for Dialogue-Driven Coding Agents
paper.abstract: AI coding agents have rapidly transformed software engineering, powering widely used interactive coding assistants. Despite their interactive real-world use, existing benchmarks evaluate them as fully-autonomous systems. In this work, we introduce Dialogue SWE-Bench, an automatic benchmark dataset for evaluating the ability of coding agents to resolve real-world software engineering problems through dialogue with a user. We design a novel, persona-grounded user simulator to support our task eval

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题很明确：现有 SWE-Bench 一类代码 agent 评测，把任务设成“拿到完整 issue 后自主修复仓库”，但真实使用里，问题描述常常不完整，用户会不断补充、纠正、拒绝方案。于是现有 benchmark 测到的主要是自治修复能力，而不是交互式澄清、需求对齐、边做边问的能力。论文把 repository-level 软件修复任务重写成 dialogue-driven setting，核心不是再造一个 coding benchmark，而是把“对话是否帮助 agent 获得缺失规格、减少误解、最终产出可通过测试的 patch”变成可自动评测的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接方法论文，但对 post-train、agent training、以及评测信号设计有现实意义。它指出一个常被忽略的断层：更强的代码模型，不一定就是更好的交互式 coding agent。这个结论会影响两类研究。第一类是 agent SFT/RL 数据构造：如果训练数据几乎都是单轮、规格完备的 coding tasks，模型就学不会主动澄清。第二类是 evaluator 设计：只看最终 patch pass rate，会掩盖 agent 在对话阶段的失误模式。贡献量级属于“评测设定补齐短板”，不是改变预训练范式，但对做 coding agent 或 tool-use post-training 的团队有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三块。第一块是 benchmark 重构。作者从 SWE-Bench Verified 出发，不再把完整 issue text 直接给 agent，而是为每个任务设计一个固定的初始用户 query，故意只暴露部分信息。agent 的动作空间在原有编程环境操作之外，新增 message_user 动作，允许它向用户提问并接收回复。这样任务成功不只取决于代码能力，也取决于是否知道什么时候问、问什么、如何根据回答更新计划。

第二块是 user simulator。论文没有用一个无约束聊天模型来扮演用户，而是做了 persona-grounded simulator：用户回复受完整 issue text 约束，并带有角色设定，目的是同时保证两点，一是回答要忠实于原始任务规格，二是交互风格要更像真实用户，而不是把标准答案一次性吐给 agent。这里的关键设计不是“让模拟器更聪明”，而是“让模拟器更稳定、可复现、不会泄露超出用户视角的信息”。从 benchmark 角度，这比开放式人类评测更便宜，也比自由生成更可控。

第三块是 schema-guided agent。作者提出一个受 dialogue theory 启发的 agent 变体，用显式 schema 约束 agent 在对话中的行为，例如区分澄清需求、确认假设、汇报进展、请求决策等不同交互意图。它不是单纯在 prompt 里加一句“多问用户”，而是把对话动作组织成更结构化的决策过程。这样做的原因很实际：通用 coding agent 往往把对话当成普通文本输出，结果要么几乎不问，要么问得泛、问得晚、问完也不用。schema 的作用是把“何时问、为何问、问完怎么改计划”显式化。
summary.experiments:
实验重点有三层。第一层是 benchmark 上的主结果。作者评测了多种现有 coding models / agents，结论是模型在传统 coding benchmark 上更强，并不自动转化为 dialogue setting 下更强。这说明交互能力不是代码能力的自然副产物，而是单独需要训练和评测的维度。

第二层是 schema-guided agent 的增益。论文给出的摘要数字是，相比强基线提升 3% 到 14%。从任务性质看，这个幅度不算小，因为 repository-level SWE 任务本来通过率就低，几个点的绝对提升通常对应不少真实任务被从“误解需求”拉回到“可修复”。更重要的是，提升来自更好的提问与对齐，而不只是更强的 patch generation。

第三层是 dialogue quality evaluation。作者除了最终 resolved rate，还引入自动化对话质量评估，并用 LLM-as-a-Judge 去看提问是否相关、是否有帮助、是否冗余等。这个设计的价值在于把失败拆开：有的 agent 代码改得对但不会沟通，有的 agent 会沟通但问不到关键点，有的 agent 过度依赖用户。论文还讨论了 better coding models do not always correspond to better interactive agents，这个观察本身比单个分数更重要。

从给出的全文片段看，数据集基于 SWE-Bench Verified 重构，评测核心仍是最终 patch 通过测试的 resolved percentage，同时叠加多种 dialogue-level 指标。若精读原文，建议重点核对：任务数规模、user simulator 的温度与稳定性设置、不同 agent 的 message frequency 分布、以及 dialogue quality 与 task success 的相关性分析。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，抓住它为什么认为 fully-autonomous SWE evaluation 不够。这里有两个关键事实：大量 issue 本身欠规格；真实用户会频繁纠正 agent，但 agent 很少主动澄清。然后看 §3.2 和 §3.3，理解 benchmark 如何从 SWE-Bench Verified 改写成交互环境，以及 simulator 如何被约束，避免信息泄露和高方差。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，最值得看的部分是：Figure 2 的任务流程、user simulator 设计、主表里不同 agent 在 dialogue setting 的排名变化、以及 schema-guided agent 相对 baseline 的增益。若再多花一点时间，建议看自动 dialogue evaluation 的定义，因为这部分决定了 benchmark 是否只是在“多加一个聊天接口”，还是确实能测到交互质量。

值得深挖的点有三个。第一，初始 query 的信息遮蔽程度如何控制；遮蔽太少，dialogue 变成装饰，遮蔽太多，又可能把任务变成猜谜。第二，simulator 是否会把 benchmark 变成“对 simulator prompt 的适配”。第三，schema-guided agent 的收益到底来自结构化对话，还是来自更长、更谨慎的 prompting。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a clear gap in coding-agent evaluation: existing SWE benchmarks mostly assume a fully specified issue and measure autonomous repository repair, while real usage is interactive and often underspecified. In practice, users clarify requirements, reject wrong assumptions, and steer the agent mid-trajectory. The paper reformulates repository-level software repair into a dialogue-driven benchmark, so the key question becomes whether an agent can ask useful questions, recover missing specification through interaction, and still produce a test-passing patch.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for post-training, agent training, and evaluation design. The main takeaway is operationally important: stronger coding models do not automatically become stronger interactive coding agents. That has implications for training data construction and reward design. If agent SFT/RL data mostly contains single-turn, fully specified coding tasks, the model has little incentive to learn clarification behavior. It also matters for evaluation: patch success alone hides whether the agent failed because of coding, planning, or dialogue. The contribution is best viewed as a benchmark correction for an important missing capability rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, the benchmark reformulation. Starting from SWE-Bench Verified, the full issue text is no longer given to the agent upfront. Instead, each task begins with a fixed initial user query that only partially exposes the problem. The agent keeps its normal programming actions but gains an additional message_user action, allowing it to ask follow-up questions and receive replies. This changes the task from pure code repair to joint specification elicitation plus code repair.

Second, the user simulator. Rather than using an unconstrained chat model, the paper builds a persona-grounded simulator whose responses are anchored to the full issue text. The design goal is twofold: preserve faithfulness to the original task specification, and produce realistic user-style interaction without leaking omniscient information. This is an important benchmarking choice. A free-form simulator would be cheaper to build but much noisier and less reproducible; a tightly grounded simulator makes automatic evaluation more stable.

Third, the schema-guided agent. The proposed agent is informed by dialogue theory and uses an explicit interaction schema to structure user communication, such as clarification, assumption checking, progress reporting, and decision requests. This is more than adding a prompt like “ask the user when needed.” The point is to make dialogue a structured policy component rather than incidental text generation. In many off-the-shelf coding agents, dialogue is either underused or poorly timed; the schema is intended to make asking behavior purposeful and actionable.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments support three main claims. First, benchmark results show that stronger coding models in the standard autonomous setting do not necessarily rank higher in the dialogue setting. That is the central empirical result: interactive competence is not a free byproduct of better code generation.

Second, the proposed schema-guided agent improves over strong baselines by 3 to 14 percent, according to the paper’s headline numbers. For repository-level SWE tasks, that is a meaningful gain because absolute solve rates are typically low and a few points often correspond to a substantial number of recovered tasks. The paper argues that the gain comes from better clarification and alignment, not just stronger patch synthesis.

Third, the paper augments task success with automatic dialogue-quality evaluation using an LLM judge. This helps separate failure modes: some agents code well but do not communicate, some communicate but ask low-value questions, and some over-query the user. That decomposition is useful because final patch accuracy alone cannot explain why an agent failed.

From the provided full text, the benchmark is built by reformulating SWE-Bench Verified, the primary task metric remains resolved percentage via unit tests, and dialogue-level metrics are added on top. When reading the full paper, it is worth checking the exact task count, simulator settings, message frequency statistics, and the correlation between dialogue quality and task resolution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction. The most important setup is why fully autonomous SWE evaluation is insufficient: many real issues are underspecified, and users frequently correct agents while agents rarely seek clarification. Then read the benchmark reformulation and simulator sections carefully, especially how the environment is modified and how the simulator is constrained to avoid information leakage and high variance.

If you only spend 20 to 30 minutes, focus on the task-flow figure, the simulator design, the main ranking table showing how agents reorder under dialogue evaluation, and the ablation or comparison for the schema-guided agent. If you have more time, read the dialogue-quality evaluation section, because that determines whether the benchmark measures meaningful interaction quality or merely adds a chat channel.

Three questions are worth probing. How much information is hidden in the initial query? If too little is hidden, dialogue becomes cosmetic; if too much is hidden, the task becomes guesswork. Does the simulator introduce a new overfitting target? And does the schema-guided gain come from genuinely better interaction structure or simply from longer, more cautious prompting?

recommendation.zh: 把“交互式澄清”从 demo 拉回可自动评测，方向是对的；读数据构造+user simulator 设计即可，别太相信 3-14% 的绝对数（模拟器偏置风险）。
recommendation.en: It makes interactive clarification measurable rather than a demo; read the dataset construction and user-simulator design, but treat the 3–14% gains cautiously due to simulator bias.

paper.title: tap: A File-Based Protocol for Heterogeneous LLM Agent Collaboration
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent software development systems have proposed many forms of agent collaboration, including role-based collaboration and automated code review. However, many systems assume a common runtime, a central conversation server, or the same API family. Under these assumptions, LLM agents from different vendors cannot easily exchange messages directly from their own execution environments while dividing development and review work on a shared codebase. This paper presents tap, a file-ba

summary.core_problem: 不同厂商的代码 Agent 往往依赖不同运行时、API 和对话环境，难以在同一代码库上直接协作。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个轻量协作协议，而不是新模型。它关注异构 LLM Agent 的互操作性，对 coding agent 系统工程有参考价值，但对基座预训练没有直接方法增益。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 tap，一种 file-based collaboration protocol。核心是 file-first 设计：用带 metadata 的 markdown 文件保留原始消息；Tier 1 通过文件检查通信；Tier 2 使用 Claude 和 Codex 的实时通知路径；用独立 git worktree 隔离各 Agent 的工作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出系统性 benchmark、任务数量、成功率或和现有 multi-agent coding 系统的量化对比。主要展示 Claude 与 Codex 在无共享内存、无相同运行时条件下协作一个代码库的协议设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Coding agents from different vendors often cannot collaborate directly because existing systems assume a shared runtime, central conversation server, or common API family.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a lightweight interoperability protocol rather than a new model. It is relevant to coding-agent infrastructure, but only weakly informative for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces tap, a file-based collaboration protocol. It uses markdown files with metadata as durable message records, combines file inspection as Tier 1 communication with real-time notification paths as Tier 2, and isolates agent work through separate git worktrees.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report a systematic benchmark, task count, success rate, or quantitative comparison against other multi-agent coding systems. It focuses on demonstrating Claude-Codex collaboration without shared memory or identical runtime.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent 互操作的小协议，不是模型研究；做 coding-agent infra 可备查，预训练侧不必读正文。
recommendation.en: This is an interoperability protocol, not model research; keep it as a coding-agent infra reference, skip for pretraining.

paper.title: IterCAD: An Iterative Multimodal Agent for Visually-Grounded CAD Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Computer-Aided Design is pivotal in modern manufacturing, yet existing automated methods predominantly rely on open-loop, one-shot generation, creating a mismatch with iterative real-world practices. In this paper, we present IterCAD, a unified multimodal agent framework for closed-loop, interactive CAD generation and editing. We formulate the task as a multi-turn interaction between a multimodal agent and an executable CAD sandbox, covering three tasks: Drawing-to-Code, Text-to-Code, and Intera

summary.core_problem: 解决现有自动化CAD生成方法多为开环一次性生成、与真实工业迭代式设计流程不匹配的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新+Benchmark贡献；提出闭环多模态CAD Agent框架，配套数据合成管线与评测套件IterCAD-Bench
summary.technical_approach: 将CAD生成建模为多模态Agent与可执行CAD沙箱的多轮交互，覆盖绘图转代码、文本转代码、交互编辑三类任务；用融合工业制造特征的数据合成管线生成训练数据，通过渐进式SFT+带可行前缀掩码的几何感知RL优化Agent
summary.experiments: 在自研IterCAD-Bench评测套件上验证了闭环交互生成相比开环一次性生成的优势，代码可执行性与几何精度均有提升

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the mismatch between existing open-loop one-shot automated CAD generation methods and real-world iterative industrial design workflows
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation + benchmark contribution; proposes a closed-loop multimodal CAD agent framework with a data synthesis pipeline and IterCAD-Bench evaluation suite
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates CAD generation as multi-turn interaction between a multimodal agent and executable CAD sandbox; uses industrial feature-augmented data synthesis pipeline for training; optimizes agent via progressive SFT + geometry-aware RL with viable-prefix masking
summary_en.experiments: Validates closed-loop generation outperforms open-loop one-shot generation on IterCAD-Bench, with improvements in code executability and geometric fidelity

recommendation.zh: 特定CAD领域的代码Agent工作，可行前缀掩码提升可执行性的思路可参考，但领域过窄，仅看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Domain-specific coding agent for CAD; viable-prefix masking for executability is marginally informative, but narrow scope means only the abstract is worth reading

paper.title: Structured Testbench Generation for LLM-Driven HDL Design and Verification-Oriented Data Curation
paper.abstract: Automated testbench generation has become a critical bottleneck in large language model (LLM)-driven Register Transfer Level (RTL) workflows, where large numbers of candidate designs must be verified rapidly and reliably. Existing prompt-based approaches treat testbench generation as unconstrained code synthesis, yielding stochastic outputs with high token cost, low reproducibility, and insufficient coverage. To address this gap, we present STG, a Structured Testbench Generation framework that e

summary.core_problem: LLM 生成 RTL 设计时，测试平台生成成本高、随机性强、覆盖不足，导致候选硬件设计难以及时可靠验证。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 HDL/RTL 代码生成工作流的确定性验证工具和数据清洗工具。它对代码 Agent 的训练数据筛选和 benchmark 质量有参考价值，但领域较窄，不直接推进通用 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: STG 利用硬件设计自身的结构信息生成确定性 testbench，而不是把 testbench 生成当作开放式 LLM 代码合成问题。框架同时用于直接验证候选 DUT，并作为数据整理引擎发现错误 benchmark testbench 和过滤 RTL 生成数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 STG 相比迭代式 LLM testbench 生成流程快 720 倍，编译成功率更高、覆盖率更高，并减少错误 DUT 的 false-pass；作为数据清洗引擎，在单个计算资源设置下比 LLM 过滤快 11 倍。摘要未给出模型参数量和完整数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: In LLM-driven RTL design, testbench generation is slow, stochastic, token-expensive, and often insufficient for reliable verification of many candidate designs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a deterministic HDL verification and data-curation tool. It is relevant to coding-agent data quality and benchmark hygiene, but it is domain-specific and does not directly advance general LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: STG uses the inherent structure of hardware designs to generate deterministic testbenches instead of treating testbench construction as unconstrained LLM code synthesis. It serves both as a direct DUT verification tool and as a data-curation engine that exposes faulty benchmark tests and filters RTL generation data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 720x speedup over an iterative LLM-based testbench generation flow, with higher compilation success, higher coverage, and fewer false-pass outcomes on incorrect DUTs. As a data-curation engine, it is reported to be 11x faster than LLM-based filtering on a single compute setup. Model sizes and full dataset scales are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 读实验和失败案例即可；它提醒代码数据清洗应尽量用结构化 verifier，而不是再堆 LLM 判别器。
recommendation.en: Skim the experiments and failure cases; the useful lesson is to prefer structured verifiers over another LLM judge for code-data filtering.

paper.title: AI Coding Agents Can Reproduce Social Science Findings
paper.abstract: Recent anecdotal evidence suggests that AI coding agents can reproduce published findings when provided with original data and code; yet systematic evaluation across social sciences remains limited. Existing evaluation benchmarks are insufficient, either small or conflate agent performance with problems in the reproduction materials themselves, such as code that fails to execute correctly. Here we introduce SocSci-Repro-Bench, a benchmark of 221 tasks spanning four disciplines and 13 substantive

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答一个更干净的问题：当前 frontier coding agents 在给定原始数据和代码的前提下，究竟能否稳定复现社会科学论文结果，而不是被 benchmark 本身的材料缺陷混淆。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark 设计。它把“agent 不会复现”和“原始复现材料本来就坏”这两件事拆开，构造了更可解释的 coding-agent 评测集。这对 agent eval 设计有参考价值，也能给 post-train/agent 训练提供更干净的目标信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SocSci-Repro-Bench，收集 221 个任务，覆盖四个学科和 13 个主题领域，并显式区分两类样本：一类是用公开材料可完全复现的研究，另一类是因缺失数据等原因可证明不可复现的研究。这样可以把 agent 的执行、调试、环境适配和研究复现能力，与数据材料缺陷分离开来。随后评测 Claude Code 与 Codex 两个 coding agents。
summary.experiments: 基准包含 221 个任务。结果上，Claude Code 与 Codex 都能复现相当比例的社会科学发现，且 Claude Code 明显优于 Codex；其复现率高于先前一般 LLM-based agents 的报告。摘要未给出具体成功率、运行预算和 pass criteria，因此读正文时应重点看任务过滤规则、环境标准化和评分协议是否足够严格。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Oxford、University of Zurich、Carnegie Mellon University、New York University。Joshua Tucker 在计算社会科学与政治传播方向较知名，但这不是基座模型团队论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a cleaner question: can frontier coding agents actually reproduce published social-science findings when given original data and code, without conflating agent failure with broken reproduction materials?
