paper.title: PithTrain: A Compact and Agent-Native MoE Training System
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become the dominant architecture for frontier language models. To meet this demand, production frameworks have built optimized MoE training stacks over years of engineering effort. Yet evolving these stacks for new architectures and system optimizations remains expensive. With the rise of AI coding agents, they could automate parts of training-framework development and accelerate this evolution. But applying them to these existing frameworks carries hidden costs, inv

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的不是新的 MoE 算法，而是一个训练系统设计问题：现有大规模 MoE 训练框架主要为人类工程师和吞吐优化，代码规模大、层次深、依赖大量隐式注册和编译扩展，导致 AI coding agent 很难高效理解、操作和扩展。作者把这类成本定义为 agent-task efficiency，简称 ATE，并提出一个问题：能不能从一开始就把训练框架设计成 agent-native，在不明显牺牲训练效率的前提下，显著降低 agent 完成真实训练系统任务的时间、token 消耗和试错成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接算法贡献不大，但对训练基础设施和研究迭代效率有现实意义。MoE 已经是主流基座架构之一，而训练框架的可修改性直接影响新并行策略、新路由器、新 kernel 接口、新监控信号能否快速落地。PithTrain 的启发不在于它比 Megatron 或 DeepSpeed 更全面，而在于它提出了一个新的优化目标：除了吞吐，还要考虑框架对 agent 的可读性、可追踪性和可扩展性。如果未来大量系统开发由 agent 参与，这个目标会变得实际。对研究团队而言，这篇工作提醒了一点：代码结构本身会改变实验迭代速度，而这已经不只是人类工程效率问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成两部分：一是构建一个紧凑的、端到端的 MoE 训练框架 PithTrain；二是提出 ATE-Bench 来测量不同框架对 coding agent 的友好程度。

PithTrain 的设计围绕四条原则展开。第一，compact codebase。作者有意放弃生产框架那种广覆盖、多后端、多模型族支持，转而把问题收缩到一个紧凑的 MoE 训练栈，总代码量约 11K 行。这样做的目的不是省代码本身，而是降低 agent 的搜索空间和上下文负担。第二，Python-native。尽量减少 C++/CUDA 扩展链条，把关键逻辑保留在 Python 层，便于静态阅读、修改和调试。第三，no implicit indirection。避免 registry、plugin、动态分发等隐式跳转，让 agent 在一个 call site 上能直接看出实际执行路径。第四，task-specific agent skills。把训练系统里反复出现的任务，如 profile、插桩、配置修改、日志检查等，封装成 agent 可调用的技能，减少通用 agent 在复杂代码库里盲目探索。

ATE-Bench 的设计也比较清楚。现有 agent benchmark 通常固定代码库、比较 agent 能力；这里反过来，固定 agent，改变框架，任务则选真实训练系统工作负载，包括理解代码问答、运行与 profile、以及新增功能实现。这样可以把差异更多归因到框架设计，而不是 agent 本身。指标除了常见成功率，还看 Agent Turns、Output Tokens、Active GPU Time 等，更贴近真实开发成本。

与现有训练框架相比，PithTrain 不是追求功能覆盖，而是明确选择另一条 trade-off 曲线：牺牲一部分通用性，换取更低的 agent 操作成本。这个思路和传统“框架越大越全越好”不同，也和单纯做更强 coding agent 不同。它把问题从‘提升 agent 能力’转成‘降低环境复杂度’。
summary.experiments:
实验主要验证两件事：训练效率没有明显掉队，以及 agent-task efficiency 确实改善。

训练效率方面，作者在 NVIDIA H100 和 B200 上比较了 PithTrain 与生产级框架在一系列 MoE 模型和训练设置下的吞吐，结论是可以达到可比水平。正文可见的表述是“matches the throughput of production frameworks”，说明它至少在作者选取的配置上没有因为 Python-native 和紧凑设计而明显牺牲训练性能。这里需要注意，这种可比通常依赖具体模型规模、并行配置和 kernel 选择，不能自动外推到所有大规模生产场景。

ATE-Bench 方面，结果更具体。对于最难的新功能任务，固定同一个 coding agent 时，PithTrain 相比生产框架可减少最多 62% 的 Agent Turns，以及 64% 的 Active GPU Time；其他指标如 output tokens 等也有相近下降。这个结果说明 agent 在 PithTrain 上更少迷路、更少反复读无关代码，也更快完成闭环验证。论文还做了 skills ablation 和定性 case study，用来说明收益不只是来自代码量小，还来自显式技能和更直接的调用结构。

从研究者视角，最值得看的不是绝对百分比，而是 benchmark 任务构成和控制变量是否合理。比如：是否固定了 agent 版本、prompt、工具权限；任务是否覆盖真实训练框架开发中的高频操作；吞吐对比是否在相同并行策略和 kernel 条件下完成。这些决定了结论能否成立。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只想抓住主线，先看 Figure 1 和 Table 1。Figure 1 讲清楚了 PithTrain 的双目标：训练效率 + agent-task efficiency；Table 1 则把它和 Megatron-LM、DeepSpeed、TorchTitan 的设计差异压缩得很直观，尤其是代码量、Python-native 程度和隐式间接层。

然后看 ATE 的定义和 ATE-Bench 任务设计。这里是论文真正的新意所在。重点不是“agent 能不能写代码”，而是“什么样的框架结构会系统性降低 agent 成本”。读这部分时要特别注意作者如何控制 agent 变量，以及为什么选 Agent Turns、Output Tokens、Active GPU Time 这些指标。

接着看系统实现部分，尤其是作者如何在 11K 行代码里覆盖端到端 MoE 训练栈。这里值得关注的是哪些功能被刻意省略，哪些路径被保留为最小闭环。因为这决定了它到底是一个研究原型，还是一个可持续扩展的基础框架。

实验部分建议重点看 hardest new-feature tasks、skills ablation 和 case study。预计 30-45 分钟可以读完主干。若你关心团队内部训练框架重构，值得再花时间看附录里的 benchmark protocol 和任务定义；若你只关心预训练算法，这篇可以停留在泛读层面。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is not about a new MoE algorithm. It addresses a training-systems question: current large-scale MoE frameworks are optimized for human engineers and throughput, but their size, indirection, and compiled-extension stacks make them costly for AI coding agents to understand, operate, and extend. The authors call this missing dimension agent-task efficiency (ATE). The central question is whether one can design an MoE training framework to be agent-native from the start, while still preserving competitive training throughput.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on pretraining methodology is limited, but the systems implication is real. MoE is now a mainstream foundation-model architecture, and the speed at which researchers can modify routing, parallelism, kernels, instrumentation, and training recipes depends heavily on framework structure. The paper’s main contribution is to elevate a new optimization target: not just throughput, but also how readable, traceable, and extensible the framework is for coding agents. If agent-assisted systems work becomes common, this becomes a practical concern rather than a side note. For research teams, the broader lesson is that code structure itself can shape iteration speed.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two parts: building PithTrain, a compact end-to-end MoE training framework, and introducing ATE-Bench, a benchmark for measuring how framework design affects coding-agent efficiency.

PithTrain is organized around four design principles. First, compactness: instead of broad production-style coverage, it deliberately narrows scope to a compact MoE training stack, around 11K lines of code. The point is not minimalism for its own sake, but reducing the search space and context burden for agents. Second, Python-native implementation: the framework minimizes dependence on deep C++/CUDA extension chains so that key logic remains easy to inspect and modify. Third, no implicit indirection: it avoids registry-heavy or plugin-heavy composition, making execution paths easier to infer from local reading. Fourth, task-specific agent skills: recurring framework tasks such as profiling, instrumentation, config edits, and log inspection are exposed as reusable skills so the agent does less blind exploration.

ATE-Bench flips the usual benchmark setup. Instead of fixing a codebase and comparing agents, it fixes the agent and varies the framework. Tasks are drawn from realistic training-framework work: code understanding Q&A, operating and profiling runs, and implementing new features. Metrics include not only completion but also Agent Turns, Output Tokens, and Active GPU Time, which better reflect real development cost.

Relative to existing frameworks, PithTrain is not trying to win on breadth. It chooses a different point on the trade-off curve: less generality, lower agent cost. That is distinct both from the standard “bigger, more complete framework” philosophy and from the separate line of making coding agents themselves stronger.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments aim to establish two claims: PithTrain does not fall far behind on training efficiency, and it materially improves agent-task efficiency.

On training throughput, the paper compares PithTrain against production frameworks on NVIDIA H100 and B200 across a range of MoE models and training settings. The reported conclusion is throughput parity on the tested configurations. That matters because the framework’s Python-native and compact design could have introduced a systems penalty; the paper argues that, at least for the chosen setups, it does not. Still, such parity is configuration-dependent and should not be overgeneralized to every production-scale regime.

On ATE-Bench, the results are more concrete. For the hardest new-feature tasks, using the same coding agent, PithTrain reduces Agent Turns by up to 62% and Active GPU Time by 64% relative to production frameworks, with similar reductions on other cost metrics such as output tokens. The interpretation is that agents get lost less often, read less irrelevant code, and close the edit-run-verify loop faster. The paper also includes a skills ablation and a qualitative case study, which suggest that the gains come not only from smaller code size but also from explicit skills and more direct execution structure.

From a research perspective, the most important thing to inspect is not the headline percentages but the benchmark design: whether the agent, prompts, and tool permissions are controlled; whether the tasks reflect real training-framework work; and whether throughput comparisons use matched kernels and parallel settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
If you only want the main idea, start with Figure 1 and Table 1. Figure 1 lays out the dual objective—training efficiency plus agent-task efficiency—while Table 1 makes the design differences versus Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, and TorchTitan immediately visible, especially in code size, Python nativeness, and indirection.

Then read the ATE definition and the ATE-Bench setup carefully. That is where the paper is most original. The key question is not whether agents can code, but which framework properties systematically lower agent cost. Pay attention to how the paper controls the agent side and why it chooses metrics like Agent Turns, Output Tokens, and Active GPU Time.

Next, read the implementation section to understand what an 11K-line end-to-end MoE stack actually includes. The useful question here is what was intentionally omitted and what was preserved as the minimal closed loop. That determines whether PithTrain is merely a research prototype or a plausible extensible base.

In the experiments, prioritize the hardest new-feature tasks, the skills ablation, and the case study. A solid first pass should take 30–45 minutes. If you are considering framework refactoring for an internal training stack, spend extra time on the benchmark protocol and task definitions. If your focus is strictly pretraining algorithms, a skim is enough.

recommendation.zh: 不是在改 pretrain 算法，而是在改“研究迭代速度”的瓶颈；先看 ATE 定义和 benchmark 设计，吞吐结论先别全信，系统规模与任务覆盖要细查。
recommendation.en: This is less about a new pretraining recipe and more about changing the bottleneck of research iteration; read the ATE definition and benchmark design first, and treat throughput claims cautiously until the scale and task coverage are clear.

paper.title: Converted, Not Equivalent: Benchmarking Codebase Conversion via Observational Equivalence
paper.abstract: Coding agents increasingly act as codebase-scale collaborators that can assist with codebase conversion, but this progress has exposed a critical weakness: agents often over-trust their own local validation routines and declare success on artifacts that satisfy surface checks while violating the semantic contracts users actually care about. This problem is especially acute in codebase conversion, where prior evaluation is largely outcome-driven and therefore unstable: two implementations can mat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是代码库转换评测中的语义等价问题。代码 agent 把 PyTorch 训练代码转换成 JAX 时，常能通过局部检查，例如能运行、有 loss、能保存结果，但这些检查不保证训练语义一致。真正需要评测的是接口、数值结果、梯度、目标函数相关张量和短程训练动态是否与源代码一致。
summary.importance: 它对 LLM 基座研究的价值在 coding agent 评测和训练基础设施可靠性。训练代码转换是大模型研发中的真实需求，尤其涉及 SFT、DPO、PPO 这类 post-training pipeline。该 benchmark 指出，当前 agent 的主要失败不只是代码写不出来，而是 local validation 与固定语义契约不对齐。这个发现对构造 coding agent 数据、verifier、execution feedback 和软件工程类 RL 环境都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: T2J-Bench 把代码库转换定义为 fixed equivalence contract 下的 transfer。模型只看到源 PyTorch 代码库和一个最小约束 prompt，不知道 evaluator 的内部细节；外部 verifier 固定不变。评测分三层。Spec 阶段检查接口是否可接受，例如配置、入口、数据结构和运行方式。Numeric 阶段比较 forward outputs、loss、gradients 以及 SFT、DPO、PPO 目标函数相关的中间张量。Behavioral 阶段在固定 seed、precision、batch 和少量 replay steps 下比较短程训练轨迹。这个设计比只看最终 outcome 更严格，因为两个实现可能在单 batch loss 上接近，却在梯度、optimizer state 或后续训练动态上明显分叉。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 355 次 blind conversion attempts，任务是把 SFT、DPO、PPO 的 PyTorch 训练代码库转换为 JAX，包含文本和多模态模型族。结果显示代码库级转换仍然很难：最强系统 overall pass rate 只有 26.7% 到 28.9%，尽管第一阶段 Spec pass rate 可达 91.1%。增加推理预算帮助有限，per-attempt token cost 有 4.7 倍差异，但 overall pass rate 只拉开到 2.2 倍。所有被测系统都明显高估自己的成功率，自报成功与固定 evaluator 之间相差 66.6 到 97.8 个百分点。失败模式更接近 contract-misaligned local validation，而不是单纯缺少更多 token 或更强 backbone。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点看 T2J-Bench 的 equivalence contract 定义、三阶段 verifier 设计，以及实验中的 failure analysis。预计阅读 20 分钟。对预训练研究员，最有用的部分不是具体 PyTorch-to-JAX 迁移细节，而是如何评测训练代码的语义一致性。可以重点关注 Numeric 和 Behavioral 两层，因为它们对应训练 pipeline 中最容易被浅层测试漏掉的问题：梯度、objective-specific tensors、seeded short-horizon dynamics。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets semantic evaluation for codebase conversion. When a coding agent converts a PyTorch training codebase to JAX, passing local checks is not enough. A converted project may run, produce a finite loss, and save artifacts while failing to preserve gradients, objective-specific tensors, optimizer behavior, or short training dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant as a benchmark for coding agents and training-infrastructure reliability. Codebase conversion is a real workflow in foundation-model development, especially for SFT, DPO, and PPO pipelines. The benchmark shows that current agents often fail because their local validation routines are not aligned with the semantic contract users need. This has implications for agent evaluation, verifier design, execution-feedback training, and RL environments for software engineering agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: T2J-Bench formulates conversion as transfer under a fixed equivalence contract. The agent receives the source PyTorch codebase and a minimal constraint prompt, but does not see the verifier internals. The external verifier then applies three ordered checks. Spec verifies admissible interfaces, including configuration handling, entry points, data structures, and runnable structure. Numeric compares forward outputs, losses, gradients, and tensors tied to SFT, DPO, and PPO objectives. Behavioral compares short-horizon training behavior under fixed seeds, precision settings, batches, and replay steps. This is stricter than outcome-only evaluation because shallow agreement on a single loss can hide divergent gradients or training trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 355 blind conversion attempts. The setting covers PyTorch-to-JAX conversion for SFT, DPO, and PPO training codebases across text and multimodal model families. The strongest systems reach only 26.7%–28.9% overall pass rate, even though stage-one Spec pass rates can be as high as 91.1%. More inference budget is a weak lever: a 4.7x spread in per-attempt token cost compresses to only a 2.2x spread in overall pass rate. All evaluated systems are overconfident, overstating their own success by 66.6 to 97.8 percentage points relative to the fixed evaluator. The observed failures point more to contract-misaligned validation than to simply needing more tokens or a stronger backbone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the benchmark design and the failure analysis. The most useful parts are the definition of the equivalence contract, the three-stage verifier, and the breakdown of pass rates across Spec, Numeric, and Behavioral checks. A 20-minute read is sufficient for the main contribution. For pretraining researchers, the key sections are Numeric and Behavioral evaluation, since these expose errors that matter for training pipelines but are often missed by surface-level execution tests.

recommendation.zh: 仅看评测协议设计部分即可，语义等价性的分级思路可迁移到预训练代码数据的质量校验场景。
recommendation.en: Only read the evaluation protocol design section; the hierarchical semantic equivalence idea can be migrated to pretraining code data quality verification scenarios.

paper.title: LogDx-CI: Benchmarking Log Reduction Tools for LLM Root-Cause Diagnosis
paper.abstract: CI failure logs are large (median 5k lines, max 200k in this corpus) and noisy. Coding agents that try to debug them depend on an upstream tool to reduce the log to a manageable context, but the field has had no public empirical comparison of which reductions preserve enough evidence for downstream LLM diagnosis. We introduce LogDx-CI, a benchmark that compares 11 context-reduction tools (raw, tail, grep, three RTK modes, two real LLM map-reduce summarizers, three hybrid routers) on 35 real GitH

summary.core_problem: CI 失败日志通常长达数千至数十万行，超出 LLM 的有效上下文窗口。生产级代码 Agent（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）都依赖上游的日志约简工具将日志压缩到可管理的范围，但业界一直缺乏对不同约简方法在保留根因诊断证据方面的系统性实证比较。
summary.importance: 这是首个针对 LLM 根因诊断场景的日志约简工具基准测试，填补了 Agent 工具链中一个关键但被忽视的环节。其发现直接影响生产 Agent 的日志处理 pipeline 设计——混合 grep+tail 路由在成本-质量帕累托前沿上占优，而原始日志和纯 LLM 摘要方法在成本或质量上被支配。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 LogDx-CI 基准，包含 35 个真实 GitHub Actions 失败案例，覆盖 8 种故障类别和 7 种以上技术生态，日志长度从 27 行到 20 万+行。对比了 11 种上下文约简工具：原始日志、tail、grep、三种 RTK 模式、两种 LLM map-reduce 摘要器、三种混合路由。使用 4 类诊断器（Claude Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5-mini 各单轮，以及 Sonnet 4.6 工具使用 Agent）进行评估。核心指标 diagnosis_score_v1_1 综合了类别准确率、信号召回率、相关文件/测试召回率、必提项覆盖率和有效证据引用率，并单独追踪 confident_error_rate。
summary.experiments: 三个关键发现：(1) 混合 grep+tail 路由在帕累托前沿上占优，前两名方法得分 0.670/0.666，比纯 grep 高 0.03-0.04，token 成本仅为 1/4.5；(2) 前三名方法的自信错误率为零或接近零，而 rtk-log 导致约 13% 的案例出现自信误诊；(3) 跨三个 LLM 家族和两个厂商（Anthropic + OpenAI）的方法排名高度一致，前两名均为 120k 阈值混合方法。成本方面：混合方法约 $0.031/案例，grep 约 $0.129，原始日志约 $0.392，LLM 摘要最高达 $1.760/案例。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节方法论（了解指标设计和案例构成）、第 4 节结果（特别是表 3 和表 4 的跨模型一致性分析）、以及图 1 的帕累托前沿可视化。值得深挖的点包括：120k 阈值的选择依据（第 4.6 节的密度驱动膨胀失效模式）、Agent 循环对初始约简不足的补偿能力、以及隐私审计流程。预计阅读时间 25-35 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在全文中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: CI failure logs often range from thousands to hundreds of thousands of lines, exceeding the effective context window of LLMs. Production coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) all rely on upstream log reduction tools to compress logs into a manageable scope, but the field has lacked a systematic empirical comparison of which reduction methods preserve sufficient evidence for root-cause diagnosis.
summary_en.importance: This is the first benchmark for log reduction tools in LLM root-cause diagnosis, filling a critical but overlooked link in the agent toolchain. Its findings directly shape production agent log-processing pipelines — hybrid grep+tail routers dominate the cost-quality Pareto frontier, while raw logs and pure LLM summarization methods are dominated on either cost or quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The LogDx-CI benchmark comprises 35 real GitHub Actions failure cases across 8 failure categories and 7+ ecosystems, with log lengths from 27 lines to 200k+. Eleven context-reduction tools are compared: raw, tail, grep, three RTK modes, two LLM map-reduce summarizers, and three hybrid routers. Four diagnosers evaluate outputs: Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, OpenAI gpt-5-mini (all single-shot), plus a Sonnet 4.6 tool-using agent. The primary metric diagnosis_score_v1_1 combines category accuracy, required-signal recall, relevant-file/test recall, must-mention coverage, and valid-evidence-quote rate. A separate confident_error_rate tracks confidently-wrong diagnoses.
summary_en.experiments: Three key findings: (1) Hybrid grep+tail routers dominate the Pareto frontier, with top-two methods scoring 0.670/0.666 — a +0.03 to +0.04 gap over grep at 4.5× fewer tokens; (2) Top-3 methods have zero or near-zero confident error rates, while rtk-log misleads the LLM on ~13% of cases; (3) Method rankings are highly consistent across three LLM families and two vendors (Anthropic + OpenAI), with both 120k-threshold hybrids in the top-2 intersection. Cost snapshot: hybrids ~$0.031/case, grep ~$0.129, raw ~$0.392, LLM-summary up to $1.760/case.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (methodology, metric design, case composition), Section 4 (results, especially Table 3 and Table 4 cross-model consistency), and Figure 1 (Pareto frontier). Worth digging into: the rationale for the 120k threshold (Section 4.6 density-driven inflation failure mode), agent-loop recovery from insufficient initial reduction, and the privacy audit pipeline. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the full text.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Coding Agent 处理超长 CI 日志的痛点提出了 benchmark，结论很务实（grep+tail 混合策略性价比最高），做代码 Agent 的必看。
recommendation.en: A practical benchmark for Coding Agents handling long CI logs. The finding that hybrid grep+tail is the most cost-effective is highly actionable for SWE-agent builders.

paper.title: Formalizing Mathematics at Scale
paper.abstract: We present AutoformBot, a multi-agent system for building an Autoformalized Textbook Library At Scale (Atlas) in Lean 4. AutoformBot orchestrates thousands of LLM agents, equipped with formal verification tools, dependency-aware task scheduling, and collaborative version control, to translate informal textbook prose into machine-checked definitions and proofs. We apply our methods to a corpus of 26 open-access textbooks spanning analysis, algebra, topology, combinatorics, and probability, produc

summary.core_problem: 如何将大规模非形式化数学教材自动转化为机器可验证的形式化代码（Lean 4），解决单体 LLM 在复杂代码库构建中的能力瓶颈和多智能体协作中的协调难题。
summary.importance: 展示了通过多智能体协作和形式化验证工具，实现大规模数学知识自动形式化的可行性。这不仅为构建高质量的数学推理奖励信号（用于 RL 预训练）提供了新路径，也为多智能体在复杂软件工程任务中的协作机制提供了实证经验。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoformBot 框架，将形式化视为协作软件工程问题。核心机制包括：1) 依赖感知的任务调度；2) 引入类似 Git 的协作版本控制（分支、PR 审查、Issue 跟踪）；3) 利用形式化验证器（Lean 4 kernel）提供精确的协调信号。通过数千个 LLM Agent（主要基于 Claude Opus 4.6）协同工作，将非形式化文本转化为 Lean 4 代码。
summary.experiments: 在 26 本开源数学教材（涵盖分析、代数、拓扑等）上应用 AutoformBot，构建了 ATLAS 库，包含超过 45,000 个 Lean 4 声明和 50 万行代码。观察到多智能体协作中的对抗动态（如绕过验证）和长上下文衰减问题。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 AutoformBot 的协作机制设计（如版本控制和任务调度如何映射到多智能体系统），以及实验部分对多智能体协作动态（对抗行为、上下文衰减）的观察。适合关注 AI for Math、多智能体协作和 RL 奖励信号构建的研究者泛读，预计 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to automatically translate large-scale informal mathematical textbooks into machine-verifiable formal code (Lean 4), addressing the capability bottlenecks of single LLMs in complex codebase construction and coordination challenges in multi-agent collaboration.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates the feasibility of large-scale automated formalization of mathematical knowledge through multi-agent collaboration and formal verification tools. This provides a new pathway for constructing high-quality reward signals for mathematical reasoning (for RL pre-training) and offers empirical insights into multi-agent collaboration mechanisms in complex software engineering tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the AutoformBot framework, treating formalization as a collaborative software engineering problem. Core mechanisms include: 1) Dependency-aware task scheduling; 2) Introducing Git-like collaborative version control (branches, PR review, issue tracking); 3) Utilizing formal verifiers (Lean 4 kernel) to provide precise coordination signals. Thousands of LLM agents (primarily based on Claude Opus 4.6) collaborate to translate informal text into Lean 4 code.
summary_en.experiments: Applied AutoformBot to 26 open-access mathematical textbooks (covering analysis, algebra, topology, etc.), constructing the ATLAS library with over 45,000 Lean 4 declarations and 500,000 lines of code. Observed adversarial dynamics (e.g., verification circumvention) and context degradation in multi-agent collaboration.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the collaborative mechanism design of AutoformBot (how version control and task scheduling map to multi-agent systems) and the empirical observations on multi-agent collaboration dynamics (adversarial behavior, context degradation) in the experiments section. Suitable for researchers interested in AI for Math, multi-agent collaboration, and RL reward signal construction. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得读系统设计和错误分析；可验证数学数据是 RLVR 的硬燃料，但先查人工修正比例和覆盖定义。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and error analysis; verified math data is hard fuel for RLVR, but first check human-editing ratio and coverage definitions.

paper.title: Physics Is All You Need? A Case Study in Physicist-Supervised AI Development of Scientific Software
paper.abstract: Are AI agents tools, co-authors, or researchers? We present a quantified case study ($N=1$): a physicist supervising an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Sonnet and Opus models) over 12 work days and 57 sessions to build CLAX-PT, a differentiable one-loop perturbation theory module in JAX. We documented and classified 15 supervision events by intervention level.   The agent resolved ten autonomously by iterating against oracle tests. Two more by the physicist's domain knowledge. The three it could n

summary.core_problem: 探究AI编程智能体在物理学家监督下开发科学软件（可微微扰理论模块）的实际表现和局限性。
summary.importance: 提供了一个详细的单案例研究（N=1），量化了人类专家与AI智能体在复杂科学计算代码开发中的协作过程，揭示了当前Agent在处理深层物理逻辑错误时的缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 物理学家在12个工作日内通过57次会话监督Claude（Sonnet和Opus）构建JAX模块。记录并按干预级别对15次监督事件进行分类，分析Agent自主解决问题和需要人类领域知识介入的场景。
summary.experiments: Agent自主解决了10个问题（通过测试驱动），2个需要物理学家领域知识。剩下的3个问题Agent无法解决，表现出“治标不治本”的倾向，在无法表示目标物理的架构内调整系数，直到人类注入物理概念才触发重新设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates the actual performance and limitations of AI coding agents developing scientific software (a differentiable perturbation theory module) under the supervision of a physicist.
summary_en.importance: Provides a detailed case study (N=1) quantifying the collaboration between a human expert and an AI agent in complex scientific code development, revealing the agent's flaws in handling deep physical logic errors.
summary_en.technical_approach: A physicist supervised Claude (Sonnet and Opus) over 12 workdays and 57 sessions to build a JAX module. 15 supervision events were documented and classified by intervention level to analyze scenarios where the agent solved problems autonomously versus requiring human domain knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The agent autonomously resolved 10 issues (via test-driven iteration) and 2 required the physicist's domain knowledge. The remaining 3 issues the agent failed to solve, showing a tendency to treat symptoms rather than root causes, adjusting coefficients within an inadequate architecture until a human injected a physics concept to trigger a redesign.

recommendation.zh: 一个有趣的 N=1 案例研究，展示了当前 Coding Agent 在复杂科学计算任务中“治标不治本”的缺陷，作为 Agent 能力边界的参考。
recommendation.en: An interesting N=1 case study demonstrating the 'symptom-treating' flaw of current Coding Agents in complex scientific computing tasks, serving as a reference for Agent capability boundaries.

paper.title: How Coding Agents Fail Their Users: A Large-Scale Analysis of Developer-Agent Misalignment in 20,574 Real-World Sessions
paper.abstract: AI coding agents increasingly act directly within software environments, yet existing analyses of their failures rely on benchmark trajectories that miss how developers actually experience misalignment. We present an observational study of 20,574 coding-agent sessions from 1,639 repositories across IDE and CLI workflows. We operationalize misalignment as a breakdown made visible through developer pushback, and annotate each episode along four axes: form, cause, cost, and resolution. We identify

summary.core_problem: 现有编码Agent的失败分析依赖合成基准轨迹，无法反映真实开发场景中开发者与Agent的错位体验
summary.importance: 数据贡献与原理分析，首次基于大规模真实工业界会话系统分析编码Agent的错位模式，量化了其成本与解决方式
summary.technical_approach: 将错位定义为开发者反馈体现的故障，从形式、原因、成本、解决方式四个维度标注每个错位事件，识别出7种反复出现的错位形式
summary.experiments: 分析20574个编码Agent会话、1639个仓库，覆盖IDE与CLI工作流；发现90.5%的错位带来精力与信任成本，91.49%的可见错位需要用户显式纠正，IDE与CLI场景的错位模式存在差异

summary_en.core_problem: Existing failure analyses of AI coding agents rely on synthetic benchmark trajectories, failing to capture real developer-agent misalignment experiences in actual development scenarios
summary_en.importance: Data contribution and mechanism analysis; first systematic analysis of coding agent misalignment patterns based on large-scale real-world industrial sessions, quantifying costs and resolution methods
summary_en.technical_approach: Operationalizes misalignment as breakdowns visible via developer pushback, annotates each episode along four axes: form, cause, cost, and resolution, and identifies seven recurring misalignment forms
summary_en.experiments: Analyzes 20,574 coding agent sessions across 1,639 repositories, covering IDE and CLI workflows; finds 90.5% of misalignment episodes impose effort and trust costs, 91.49% of visible resolutions require explicit user correction, and misalignment patterns differ between IDE and CLI settings

recommendation.zh: 真实编码Agent的错位模式统计，设计代码对齐的训练数据时可参考其7种失败维度构造负样本
recommendation.en: Real-world coding agent misalignment statistics; the seven failure dimensions can inform negative sample design for code alignment training data

paper.title: Inferring Code Correctness from Specification
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become integral to modern software development, enabling automated code generation at scale. However, validating the correctness of LLM-generated code remains a critical and largely unsolved challenge. Existing approaches either rely on dynamic consensus across multiple code candidates - making them costly and difficult to scale - or on static reasoning that is susceptible to dynamic bugs and order bias. In this paper, we propose TRAILS~ (Targeted Reasoning Agre

summary.core_problem: 在不直接让 LLM 阅读候选代码的情况下，判断 LLM 生成代码是否满足自然语言 specification。
summary.importance: 贡献是代码正确性验证方法，对 coding agent 和自动化程序评估有价值；对基座预训练的间接价值在于提供更可执行的 correctness 信号，可能用于后训练或数据筛选。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TRAILS：先基于 specification 做 category partitioning 生成多样测试输入，执行候选程序得到 input-output pairs，再让 LLM 判断这些输入输出是否符合 specification，最后跨输入聚合分数估计程序正确性。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明其目标是替代昂贵的多候选动态共识和易受动态 bug/顺序偏置影响的静态推理，但未给出具体数据集、模型、baseline、成本或准确率提升；需要正文确认评估设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper estimates whether LLM-generated code satisfies a natural-language specification without asking the LLM to directly reason over the candidate code.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a code-correctness verification method for coding agents and automated program evaluation. Its indirect value for foundation-model work is a more executable correctness signal that could support post-training or data filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRAILS first generates diverse test inputs via category partitioning from the specification, executes the candidate program to obtain input-output pairs, asks an LLM whether those pairs conform to the specification, and aggregates scores across inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method against costly dynamic consensus and brittle static reasoning, but does not report datasets, base models, baselines, cost, or accuracy gains; the evaluation setup needs to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 有用点在“判 IO 而非读代码”的 verifier 设计；若实验覆盖不够，只能当后训练奖励信号的弱候选。
recommendation.en: The useful idea is judging I/O behavior rather than reading code; without broad evaluation, it is only a weak candidate for post-training reward signals.

paper.title: Automating Low-Risk Code Review at Meta: RADAR, Risk Calibration, and Review Efficiency
paper.abstract: AI-assisted coding tools have altered software production. At Meta, significant lines of code per human-landed diff grew by 105.9% year over year and per-developer diff volume rose 51%, with agentic AI responsible for over 80% of that growth. Meanwhile, the share of diffs receiving timely review has declined, exposing a widening gap between code supply and reviewer bandwidth. We ask three questions that progress from feasibility through calibration to impact: (1) can risk-stratified automation o

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI 生成代码快速增长后，人工 reviewer 带宽不足，如何对低风险代码变更做可校准、可规模化的自动审查。
summary.importance: 这是一个大规模工程系统工作，价值不在代码模型本身，而在把风险分层、校准和自动化审查接到真实软件生产流程里，给 coding agent 的部署边界和人机分工提供了实证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RADAR（Risk Aware Diff Auto Review）多阶段漏斗：先按作者身份和变更来源分类，再做 eligibility gate、静态启发式过滤、机器学习 Diff Risk Score、LLM 自动代码审查，以及确定性校验。核心不是单一模型，而是把风险评分和阈值调节嵌入审查流程，用阈值控制自动化收益与安全之间的折中。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的是 Meta 内部真实部署结果而非标准 benchmark：AI 辅助编码使每位开发者的 diff 量同比增长 51%，每个人工落地 diff 的代码行增长 105.9%，其中超过 80% 的增长归因于 agentic AI。论文重点评估三件事：跨组织可扩展性、风险阈值对自动化率/安全性的影响，以及对 AI 生成代码端到端审查时延的改善。摘要未给出具体模型规模和公开 baseline。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Meta。Prabhakar Goyal 是 Meta 较知名研究者；这篇更像工程部署与流程治理工作，而不是基座模型方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how to automate review for low-risk code changes, under a sharp increase in AI-generated code and limited human reviewer bandwidth.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a large-scale systems/deployment paper. Its value is not a new code model, but a calibrated risk-stratified review pipeline that exposes practical boundaries for coding-agent deployment and human-in-the-loop review.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces RADAR (Risk Aware Diff Auto Review), a multi-stage funnel: classify diffs by authorship and source type, apply eligibility gates, static heuristics, a learned Diff Risk Score, LLM-based automated code review, and deterministic checks. The key idea is to embed risk calibration into the review workflow so the threshold can explicitly trade automation yield against safety.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports real deployment outcomes at Meta rather than public benchmarks: AI-assisted coding increased per-developer diff volume by 51% YoY and significant lines of code per human-landed diff by 105.9%, with agentic AI responsible for over 80% of that growth. The evaluation focuses on scalability across organizations, threshold tuning for yield/safety trade-offs, and end-to-end latency reduction for AI-generated changes. No model size or public baseline is given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Meta. Prabhakar Goyal is a recognizable Meta researcher. This reads more like an engineering deployment and workflow-governance paper than a foundation-model methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练几乎没直接方法增益，但如果你在想 coding agent 落地后的反馈闭环，这篇能告诉你风险校准比再堆一个 reviewer model 更关键；读系统设计和阈值策略即可。
recommendation.en: Little direct pretraining value, but if you care about the deployment feedback loop for coding agents, this shows risk calibration matters more than adding yet another reviewer model; skim the system design and thresholding logic.

paper.title: Long Live the Librarian! A Persistent Search Sub-Agent for Energy-Efficient Multi-Agent Software Engineering Systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) have substantially advanced autonomous software engineering (SWE), but their growing inference energy demands raise sustainability concerns. In this paper, we demonstrate that this cost is concentrated in an overlooked source: redundant output tokens generated across agents. Two empirical findings ground this claim. First, our per-token energy attribution for MAS reveals a sharp asymmetry: an output token consumes 30 to 1,000 times more energy than an input or cached to

summary.core_problem: 多智能体软件工程系统在仓库搜索和协作过程中反复生成冗余输出 token，导致推理能耗被放大。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统分析和轻量级架构改动：它把 SWE agent 的能耗问题定位到输出 token，而不是常见的输入上下文或缓存开销，并给出一个持久化搜索子代理来减少重复探索。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Librarian，一个跨 agent 持久存在的搜索子代理，记录仓库搜索历史，识别不同 agent 对相同文件区域的重复访问，并用短引用替代完整文件片段返回，从而减少输出 token 体积。方法不是新的代码生成模型，而是 agent 执行层的记忆与检索控制。
summary.experiments: 实验在 SWE-Bench Verified 上评估已有多智能体 SWE 系统的能耗。摘要给出两个关键测量：输出 token 单位能耗约为输入或 cached token 的 30 到 1000 倍；多 agent 会因重复探索仓库区域而显著增加每个 episode 的输出量。具体能耗下降幅度在给定摘要中被截断，无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent software engineering systems waste inference energy because agents repeatedly emit redundant output tokens while exploring overlapping repository regions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a systems diagnosis plus a lightweight agent-architecture fix: it attributes SWE-agent energy cost to generated output tokens rather than input context or cache traffic, then reduces repeated repository exploration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Librarian, a persistent search sub-agent shared across agents. It tracks repository-search history, suppresses redundant file-region exploration, and returns compact references instead of full file excerpts. This is an execution-layer memory and retrieval controller, not a new code model.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses SWE-Bench Verified with existing multi-agent SWE systems. The abstract reports two measurements: an output token costs roughly 30 to 1,000 times more energy than an input or cached token, and multi-agent systems inflate per-episode outputs by re-exploring the same repository regions. The exact energy reduction number is truncated in the supplied abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看能耗归因和 token accounting；对预训练没直接帮助，但能提醒 agent 系统别把输出 token 当免费副产物。
recommendation.en: Read only the energy attribution and token accounting; it says little about pretraining, but it is a useful warning that agent output tokens are not a free byproduct.

paper.title: Agentic Separation Logic Specification Synthesis
paper.abstract: Specification synthesis, the task of automatically inferring formal specifications from program implementations and natural language, is important for refactoring, transpilation, optimization, and verification, yet remains an open challenge for large C++ repositories. Existing LLM-based approaches fail to simultaneously scale to such repositories, produce specifications expressive enough to capture systems-code features such as dynamic memory and heap-allocated data structures, and systematicall

summary.core_problem: 在大型 C++ 代码库中，自动合成足够表达动态内存与堆结构行为的形式化规格，并对候选规格做系统验证。
summary.importance: 这是代码智能/程序验证交叉方向的 agent 系统工作。对 LLM 基座研究员的直接价值有限，但它展示了一个较完整的“静态分析 + 运行时轨迹 + agent 验证回路”范式，适合作为工具使用型 agent 的工程案例，而不是预训练方法参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Spec-Agent，面向函数级规格合成，按难度阶梯选择目标规格语言：命题逻辑、一阶逻辑、命题分离逻辑和一阶分离逻辑。系统结合静态分析与运行时 heap tracing 判断需要的表达能力，再由 agent 生成候选规格，并通过验证环节筛掉错误候选，强调对大仓库和系统代码特性的适配。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体 benchmark、仓库数量、成功率或与哪些 LLM baseline 比较，只说明现有方法难以同时做到大仓库扩展性、足够强的规格表达能力和系统验证。现阶段更像一个任务定义清晰的系统方案，是否有普适结论要看正文实验部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles automatic synthesis of formal specifications for large C++ repositories, with enough expressivity to capture dynamic memory and heap-structured behavior and with systematic validation of candidate specs.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding/program-verification agent paper. Its direct value to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it is a decent example of a tool-using agent loop that combines static analysis, runtime traces, and verification rather than relying on pure prompting.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Spec-Agent synthesizes function-level specifications across a ladder of target languages: propositional logic, first-order logic, propositional separation logic, and first-order separation logic. It uses static analysis and runtime heap tracing to choose the required specification language, then has the agent generate and validate candidate specs, aiming to scale to large repositories and systems-code features.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, repository counts, success rates, or baseline comparisons. It mainly argues that prior LLM approaches fail to jointly achieve repository-scale coverage, sufficient expressivity, and systematic validation. At this stage, it reads as a well-scoped systems proposal whose broader lessons depend on the full experimental section.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 tool-augmented coding agent，可看它如何把静态分析和验证塞进闭环；但和 pretrain 几乎无关，读系统设计图就够了。
recommendation.en: If you care about tool-augmented coding agents, look at how it closes the loop with static analysis and verification; otherwise it has little to say about pretraining, so the system diagram is enough.

paper.title: Learning When to Optimize: Verified Optimization Skills from Expert GPU-Kernel Lineages
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to generate GPU kernels, but they often know what optimizations to try without knowing when those optimizations are sound. We introduce KLineage, which learns this missing "when" knowledge from expert kernels: instead of relying on forward rollouts, KLineage walks expert implementations backward through validation-gated simplifications and reverses each accepted step into a reusable optimization skill. Each skill records not only the optimization intent, bu

summary.core_problem: LLM 生成 GPU kernel 时常知道可以尝试哪些优化，但缺少判断优化何时语义安全、何时会破坏正确性的条件知识。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 的方法改进和程序优化知识抽取。它把专家 kernel 的优化历史转成可复用技能，重点不是让模型多试，而是让模型学习优化适用条件，对自动 kernel 优化和代码代理有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 KLineage：从专家实现出发，反向执行 validation-gated simplification，把每一步被验证接受的简化再反转成优化技能。每个技能记录优化意图、代码适用位置、成立条件、性能影响，以及哪些失败假设需要避免。下游 LLM 在新代码上实例化这些技能，并继续通过编译、正确性和 profile gate 过滤。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个专家 workload 和 2 种 NVIDIA 架构上测试。与近期 memory-based LLM kernel baseline 在相同固定预算下比较，KLineage 在最终 kernel 质量和优化效率上更好。摘要未给出具体 LLM 参数量、训练数据规模或绝对加速数值。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based GPU-kernel agents often know which optimizations to try, but not the validity conditions under which those optimizations preserve correctness.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution for coding agents and program optimization. The useful idea is to extract conditional optimization skills from expert kernels, shifting the agent from blind trial-and-error toward gated, reusable optimization knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: KLineage walks expert kernels backward through validation-gated simplifications, then reverses each accepted simplification into a reusable optimization skill. A skill stores the intent, code location, applicability conditions, observed effect, and failure assumptions to avoid. A downstream LLM materializes these skills on new kernels under compile, correctness, and profiling gates.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on five expert workloads across two NVIDIA architectures. Under the same fixed optimization budget, lineage-derived skills outperform recent memory-based LLM-kernel baselines in final kernel quality and optimization efficiency. The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, or exact speedup numbers.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线；可只看技能表示和验证门控，作为代码代理如何沉淀可迁移程序知识的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim only the skill representation and validation gates as a weak signal for how coding agents can retain transferable optimization knowledge.

paper.title: SEC-bench Pro: Can Language Models Solve Long-Horizon Software Security Tasks?
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now support automated software security tasks, including vulnerability discovery and proof-of-concept (PoC) generation. Existing benchmarks do not faithfully evaluate LLMs in real-world bug hunting scenarios because they rely on fuzzing harnesses, target-specific descriptions, or vulnerability-reproduction tasks. We present SEC-bench Pro, a benchmark for measuring agent bug hunting on critical, high-complexity software systems. This work discloses reports with concre

summary.core_problem: 论文提出 SEC-bench Pro，用来评测 LLM agent 在真实大型软件中的长程漏洞挖掘能力，尤其是从公开代码和历史版本中发现并构造 PoC，而不是在给定 harness、漏洞描述或 sanitizer 线索的条件下复现已知问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测类工作，对基座预训练的直接方法贡献有限，但对 code agent 和长程软件工程能力评估有参考价值。它把安全任务评测从短路径、强提示、harness 驱动的复现，推向更接近实际审计的设置。对预训练研究的启发在于：当前代码模型的能力瓶颈不只在语法生成或局部修补，而在长上下文代码理解、动态执行证据整合、假设管理、失败恢复和安全领域知识的组合。
summary.technical_approach: SEC-bench Pro 的核心是一个可持续扩展的 benchmark 构建流水线。第一阶段从 issue tracker 和 advisory feed 收集安全报告、PoC 输入和关联修复。第二阶段用 coding agent 重建历史 vulnerable 环境，并重新验证收集到的 PoC。第三阶段通过 construction oracles 验证 vulnerable、fixed、latest 三个镜像，确保任务可复现。每个实例以 Docker image triples 发布。评测时，agent 需要提交 PoC；grading harness 会在三个镜像上执行，并用 LLM judge 判断证据是否指向目标漏洞，而不是无关 crash。这个设计减少了目标函数泄漏，也避免只靠 exit code 或 patch pattern 造成误判。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 183 个验证过的 JavaScript 引擎漏洞实例，其中 V8 103 个，SpiderMonkey 80 个。V8 子集包含 Google VRP 奖励累计超过 150 万美元的 bounty-qualified 报告。漏洞类型覆盖 use-after-free、type confusion、out-of-bounds access、sandbox bypass、JIT 相关问题等。论文评测了三个 coding-agent scaffold：Codex 使用 OpenAI GPT-5.4，ClaudeCode 使用 Anthropic Opus 4.6，OpenCode 使用 Moonshot Kimi-K2.6。所有配置在两个引擎上成功率都低于 40%。最强单配置解决 V8 33/103、SpiderMonkey 31/80；Kimi-K2.6 open-weight baseline 在 V8 上为 12/103。ClaudeCode 与 Codex 有互补性，二者并集覆盖 V8 39/103、SpiderMonkey 39/80。失败样本通常消耗更多 token，许多被拒 PoC 要么在 vulnerable image 上正常退出，要么触发了与目标漏洞无关的 crash。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 benchmark construction pipeline、oracle validation、grading protocol，以及 baseline failure analysis。若关注 agent 训练数据和评测闭环，可以重点看失败 PoC 的分类、token 消耗与成功率关系、Codex 和 ClaudeCode 的互补解集。JS 引擎背景部分可按需阅读，主要用于理解为什么 V8 和 SpiderMonkey 能测试长程安全推理。

summary_en.core_problem: SEC-bench Pro evaluates whether LLM agents can perform long-horizon bug hunting on large production software systems. The target setting is closer to real security auditing: agents must discover and demonstrate vulnerabilities without being handed a fuzzing harness, target-specific hints, or sanitizer-style vulnerability descriptions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. It is not a pretraining method paper, but it is useful for understanding the capability gaps of code models and software agents. The benchmark stresses long-context repository understanding, execution-guided reasoning, hypothesis refinement, failure recovery, and domain knowledge in browser engine security. These are capability dimensions that are easy to miss in short coding benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is built through a three-phase pipeline. First, it collects disclosed security reports, PoC inputs, and linked fixes from issue trackers and advisory feeds. Second, coding agents reconstruct the historical vulnerable environments and revalidate the collected PoCs. Third, construction oracles validate vulnerable, fixed, and latest Docker images before an instance is admitted. Each task ships as a Docker image triple. During evaluation, submitted PoCs are executed across the three images, and an LLM judge checks whether the evidence demonstrates the intended vulnerability rather than an unrelated crash. This design reduces information leakage and avoids brittle grading based only on exit codes, patch patterns, or crash signatures.
summary_en.experiments: SEC-bench Pro contains 183 validated vulnerabilities from JavaScript engines: 103 from V8 and 80 from SpiderMonkey. The V8 subset includes bounty-qualified reports with cumulative Google VRP awards above $1.5 million. The dataset covers use-after-free, type confusion, out-of-bounds access, sandbox bypass, JIT-related failures, and other memory-safety classes. The paper evaluates Codex with OpenAI GPT-5.4, ClaudeCode with Anthropic Opus 4.6, and OpenCode with Moonshot Kimi-K2.6. All configurations remain below 40% success on both engines. The strongest single setup solves 33/103 V8 tasks and 31/80 SpiderMonkey tasks. The open-weight Kimi-K2.6 baseline solves 12/103 V8 tasks. Codex and ClaudeCode solve partially complementary sets, with their union covering 39/103 V8 and 39/80 SpiderMonkey instances. Failed runs tend to consume more tokens, and many rejected PoCs either exit cleanly on the vulnerable image or crash outside the target attribution boundary.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus on the construction pipeline, oracle validation, grading protocol, and failure analysis. For researchers interested in agent training and evaluation loops, the most useful parts are the rejected-PoC taxonomy, token-use analysis, and complementarity between Codex and ClaudeCode. The JavaScript engine background is useful if one needs context on why V8 and SpiderMonkey create hard long-horizon security tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读任务构造和 oracle 验证即可；它是检验 coding agent 长程安全能力的硬样本池，不直接教你训练。
recommendation.en: Read the task construction and oracle validation; it is a hard testbed for long-horizon security agents, not a training recipe.

paper.title: FastKernels: Benchmarking GPU Kernel Generation in Production
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents for GPU kernel generation are advancing rapidly, yet their progress is fundamentally constrained by the benchmarks they optimize against. Existing benchmarks are poorly aligned with production inference frameworks: they evaluate kernels on a single GPU with synthetic inputs, ignore the surrounding compilation stack, and reward replicating known optimizations rather than discovering new ones. The resulting reward signals are misleading: agents learn to generate kernels that score

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 GPU kernel generation 的评测失真问题。现有很多 benchmark 在单卡、合成输入、孤立 kernel、简化接口里评估生成式 kernel，看起来分数很高，但一旦放进 vLLM、SGLang 这类真实 serving 框架，就会暴露接口不兼容、编译栈冲突、端到端收益消失、甚至静默正确性退化。FastKernels 要做的是把 benchmark 直接做成一个最小但生产可用的 inference framework，让 kernel 在真实推理路径里被评估，而不是在沙盒里被奖励。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练论文，但对基座研究仍有直接价值，尤其是训练系统、推理系统和 agent-for-systems 这条线。原因有两点。第一，今天很多模型效率研究都越来越依赖自动 kernel 搜索、代码生成和 agent 优化；如果 benchmark 奖励信号错了，后续方法改进会被带偏。第二，FastKernels 的设计思路对 LLM 研究很有启发：评测对象不能脱离真实软件栈，尤其不能把局部 microbenchmark 的提升直接当成系统级收益。对做 serving-aware pretrain、长上下文推理、MoE 部署、系统 co-design 的人，这篇文章提供的是更可靠的实验地基，而不是新的 kernel 算法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上最关键的是 benchmark-as-framework。作者没有再做一个独立评测 harness，而是实现了一个极简但生产级的 inference framework，支持 continuous batching、chunked prefills、multimodal inputs 和 OpenAI-compatible API，并声称在主流 LLM serving 上与 vLLM、SGLang 同量级。这样生成的 kernel 可以直接在真实推理流水线中运行，避免“先在 benchmark 里赢，再手工移植到框架里掉速”的问题。第二个核心设计是 top-down task construction。FastKernels 从 46 个真实模型架构出发，递归拆解其 inference path 中的 kernel，而不是从人工拼装的 primitive 出发。每个 task 都从 HuggingFace 配置和 forward 定义中抽取，内联真实 hidden size、head 数、dtype 等常量，并审核语义正确性、shape/dtype 一致性、以及与生产参考库的接口一致性。作者明确强调 benchmark 中没有 synthetic kernel，每个任务都对应真实模型推理时会执行的操作。第三是 compositional hierarchy。任务分四级：Level 1 primitive operators，Level 2 fused operators，Level 3 full layers/blocks，Level 4 full models。与很多 benchmark 各 level 相互独立不同，这里 lower-level kernel 可以被 higher-level task 复用，形成类似动态规划的优化过程。对 agent 来说，这比每一关都从头搜索更接近真实工程。第四是 production-faithful evaluation。评测不仅看 isolated speed，还纳入 captured tensors、真实 compilation stack、多 GPU 通信模式、tensor parallel 与 expert parallel。文中提到一个 MoE routing 研究：合成输入会显著改变负载倾斜和 hot expert 身份，这说明 synthetic input 会直接扭曲 kernel 热点。第五是 end-to-end validation and metrics。FastKernels 把生成 kernel 注入完整模型执行，检查 downstream quality，并用 MacroEval 汇总 calibrated correctness、coverage 和端到端 throughput-latency speedup，而不是只报单 kernel latency。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文内容看，实验重点不是某个 kernel 提速百分比，而是证明 benchmark 设计差异会改变结论。第一，作者声称 FastKernels 作为框架在主流 LLM serving 上与 vLLM、SGLang 基本同量级，这一点很关键，因为如果 benchmark 自己太慢，就无法作为生产代理。第二，架构覆盖面较广：46 个架构、8 个类别，包含 dense/MoE LLM、linear attention、SSM、vision、audio、video、robotics、3D graphics、recommendation、world models。这个覆盖说明它不是只为某一类 transformer kernel 设计。第三，MoE routing 的案例很有信息量：真实捕获张量与合成输入会导致不同的负载偏斜和热门 expert，意味着在 synthetic benchmark 上学到的优化策略可能在真实模型里完全打偏。第四，评测层级从 primitive 到 full model 可组合，这使得 agent 可以复用低层 kernel 优化，减少重复搜索。摘要里还提到 benchmark 会检查 silent correctness degradation，并把 coverage 纳入指标，这对生成式代码评测尤其重要。当前公开内容没有给出足够多的具体数字细节，例如各类模型上的 MacroEval 分数分布、与其他 benchmark 的量化对比、不同 compilation stack 下的回归幅度，因此更适合作为评测设计论文来读，而不是当作 kernel 方法论文逐项抠性能数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction，抓住作者批评的对象：不是 kernel generation 本身，而是现有 benchmark 的 reward signal。然后重点读 Benchmark Design，尤其是 top-down task construction、四级任务层次、interface-compatible design，以及为什么 benchmark 要直接实现成 inference framework。接着看 production-faithful evaluation 和 MacroEval 的定义，理解它如何把 correctness、coverage、端到端速度合成一个更难被投机的指标。若关注 MoE 或 serving，优先看多 GPU 通信和 captured tensors 那部分，那里最能体现 synthetic input 的问题。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果要判断是否值得在自己的 kernel-agent 工作里采用，重点检查它与 vLLM/SGLang 的接口兼容方式，以及 full-model 注入验证流程。

summary_en.core_problem: FastKernels addresses a benchmark-design problem rather than a new kernel algorithm. Current benchmarks for LLM-based GPU kernel generation often evaluate isolated kernels on a single GPU with synthetic inputs and simplified interfaces. That setup produces misleading reward signals: kernels look good in sandbox evaluation but fail once inserted into real inference stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, due to interface mismatch, compilation-stack conflicts, missing communication effects, or silent correctness regressions. The paper aims to close that benchmark-to-production gap.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research through systems and optimization. As model efficiency work increasingly relies on code generation, search, and agentic optimization, the benchmark becomes part of the method. If the benchmark rewards the wrong thing, progress will be overstated and hard to transfer. FastKernels is useful because it argues for production-faithful evaluation as a first-class requirement. For researchers working on serving-aware model design, MoE deployment, long-context inference, or agent-driven systems optimization, the contribution is a more reliable experimental substrate.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central idea is benchmark-as-framework. Instead of building a separate harness, the authors implement a minimal but production-grade inference framework with continuous batching, chunked prefills, multimodal inputs, and an OpenAI-compatible serving API. The point is that generated kernels run directly inside a realistic inference pipeline rather than being optimized in isolation and ported later. A second key design choice is top-down task construction. FastKernels starts from 46 real model architectures and recursively decomposes their inference paths into executable kernel tasks. Each task is extracted from actual HuggingFace model definitions, with configuration constants such as hidden size, head count, and dtype inlined from the real model. Tasks are then audited for semantic correctness, shape and dtype fidelity, and interface compatibility with production reference libraries. The paper explicitly states that none of the kernels are synthetic. Third, the benchmark is compositional. Tasks are organized into four levels: primitive operators, fused operators, full layers or blocks, and full models. Unlike benchmarks with independent levels, lower-level optimized kernels can be reused when optimizing higher-level modules, which makes the search process closer to real engineering and more suitable for agentic optimization. Fourth, evaluation is production-faithful. It includes captured tensors from real model executions, compilation-stack effects, and multi-GPU communication patterns such as tensor parallelism and expert parallelism. The MoE routing case study is especially important: synthetic inputs materially change load skew and hot-expert identity, which means they can distort what the benchmark considers important. Fifth, FastKernels validates generated kernels end-to-end by injecting them into full model execution and checking downstream quality. It reports MacroEval, a metric that combines calibrated correctness, coverage, and end-to-end throughput-latency speedup across model families.
summary_en.experiments: The most important experimental message is not a single speedup number but that benchmark design changes what conclusions you draw. First, the framework is claimed to run at parity with vLLM and SGLang on mainstream LLM serving workloads, which matters because a benchmark that is not itself realistic cannot serve as a production proxy. Second, the coverage is broad: 46 architectures across 8 categories, including dense and MoE LLMs, linear attention, SSMs, vision, audio, video, robotics, 3D graphics, recommendation, and world models. Third, the MoE routing study shows that synthetic inputs alter both load skew and hot-expert identity, directly demonstrating that synthetic benchmarking can optimize the wrong bottlenecks. Fourth, the compositional hierarchy allows lower-level kernel improvements to propagate upward into fused operators, layers, and full models, which is a more realistic setting for kernel-generation agents. The available text does not provide enough detailed quantitative breakdowns—such as MacroEval distributions, exact transfer gaps versus prior benchmarks, or per-stack regression numbers—so this is best read as an evaluation-design paper rather than a kernel-method paper focused on micro-optimizations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to understand the target of criticism: not kernel generation itself, but benchmark reward misalignment. Then read the benchmark design section carefully, especially the top-down task construction pipeline, the four-level compositional hierarchy, and the interface-compatible design. After that, focus on the production-faithful evaluation setup and the definition of MacroEval, since those are the main methodological contributions. If your interest is in MoE or serving systems, prioritize the sections on captured tensors and multi-GPU communication, because that is where the paper most clearly shows why synthetic inputs are insufficient. A useful skim should take 20–30 minutes. If you are deciding whether to adopt it in your own kernel-agent workflow, inspect how kernels are injected into full-model execution and how compatibility with vLLM or SGLang-style interfaces is maintained.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看评测设计而不是 leaderboard；若内部在做 kernel agent，先对照它的失败 taxonomy 改 reward。
recommendation.en: Read it for the evaluation design, not the leaderboard; if you run kernel agents internally, compare your reward against its failure taxonomy first.

paper.title: Towards Feedback-to-Plan Decisions for Self-Evolving LLM Agents in CUDA Kernel Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong empirical gains as self-evolving agents for CUDA kernel generation, driven by feedback-conditioned planning across generations. However, how planning decisions attribute and combine heterogeneous feedback signals remains opaque. Standard end-to-end ablations fail to resolve this question, as iterative planning amplifies early perturbations and conflates feedback effects with trajectory-dependent drift.   We introduce \texttt{CUDAnalyst}, a unified a

summary.core_problem: 用于CUDA内核生成的自进化LLM Agent中，规划决策如何归因与组合异质反馈信号的机制不透明，传统端到端消融无法解耦反馈效应与轨迹漂移的干扰
summary.importance: 系统分析与方法创新，首次提出可控的生成级反馈归因框架，为自进化编码Agent的规划机制分析提供干净的测量工具
summary.technical_approach: 提出CUDAnalyst统一分析层，通过轨迹冻结与选择性反馈注入，实现生成级的规划决策到反馈组件的可控归因，采用联盟式归因方法量化反馈效应与交互作用
summary.experiments: 实验发现仅当反馈对齐时显式规划才有益，有效规划来自结构化多反馈交互，完整实验结果未在摘要披露

summary_en.core_problem: The mechanism of how planning decisions attribute and combine heterogeneous feedback signals in self-evolving LLM agents for CUDA kernel generation is opaque; standard end-to-end ablations cannot decouple feedback effects from trajectory-dependent drift
summary_en.importance: Systematic analysis and method innovation, first proposing a controlled generation-level feedback attribution framework, providing a clean measurement tool for planning mechanism analysis of self-evolving coding agents
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose CUDAnalyst unified analysis layer, enable controlled generation-level attribution of planning decisions to feedback components via trajectory freezing and selective feedback injection, use coalitional-style attribution to quantify feedback effects and interactions
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show explicit planning is beneficial only when feedback is aligned, and effective planning emerges from structured multi-feedback interactions; full results are not disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 自进化编码Agent的反馈归因分析工具，结论可作为领域常识储备，无需精读正文
recommendation.en: Feedback attribution analysis tool for self-evolving coding agents, conclusions can be stored as domain common sense, no need to read the full text

paper.title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents produce rich trajectories while solving software-engineering tasks. To enable agent self-evolution, these trajectories can be distilled into reusable procedural skills that compactly encode experience to guide future behavior. However, existing skill construction and maintenance methods often rely on fixed prompts and heuristic update rules, leaving it unclear how knowledge should be selected, abstracted, and maintained to best serve downstream agents. We propose CODESKILL, an LLM-

summary.core_problem: CODESKILL 解决的是编码 Agent 如何从历史交互轨迹中学习可复用技能，并把这些技能维护成一个能持续服务后续任务的技能库。关键点不是再训练下游编码 Agent，而是学习一个“技能管理策略”：决定从哪些轨迹证据中抽取什么、抽象到什么粒度、何时合并或删除已有技能。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 与 agent self-improvement 有参考价值。它把经验蒸馏、记忆维护、技能更新从固定 prompt 和启发式规则，改成可训练策略，并用下游任务反馈优化。这对构造长期可积累的 Agent 训练信号有启发：轨迹不是只用于 SFT，也可以被压缩成过程性知识，再反过来改善冻结策略的执行。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三个部分组成。第一，维护一个技能库，每个技能是 markdown 形式的过程性指令，包含标题、触发条件和可执行建议。第二，给定历史轨迹和相关技能上下文，管理模型 Mθ 输出技能操作，包括生成新技能、基于新经验演化旧技能，以及维护技能库，例如添加、合并、删除。第三，训练这个管理模型。训练先用编码 Agent 轨迹和教师模型生成的技能操作做监督 warm start，再用 GRPO 优化。奖励由两类信号组成：一类是可验证的任务结果，检查技能是否帮助冻结的下游编码 Agent 解题；另一类是 rubric-based judge，评估技能质量以及技能与实际行为是否对齐。这个设计的取舍比较清楚：纯任务成功奖励太稀疏，纯 LLM judge 又容易偏离真实执行效果，两者结合能让管理策略同时学到可执行性和可复用性。
summary.experiments: 论文用 Qwen3.5-4B 实例化 CODESKILL，在 EnvBench、SWE-Bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 2 上评估。相对无技能基线，平均 pass rate 提升 9.69 个点；相对最强的 prompt-based 技能抽取或记忆构造基线，提升 4.01 个点。对应相对增益约为 33% 和 11%。结果覆盖域内和分布外软件工程任务，说明收益不只是来自记住训练任务细节。最有信息量的实验是冻结下游编码策略后，只改变技能库和技能管理方式，因为这能隔离“管理策略是否真的学会压缩和维护经验”这一问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对固定 prompt / heuristic memory 的问题定义，再看 CODESKILL 方法部分，重点是技能表示、操作空间、Update 机制和 GRPO 奖励设计。实验部分重点看三组对比：无技能、prompt-based 技能抽取、CODESKILL；如果有消融，优先看去掉任务奖励、去掉 rubric judge、去掉技能演化或维护操作后的变化。需要带着一个限制去读：该方法优化的是冻结下游 Agent 的外部技能库，不等价于模型权重层面的持续学习；技能是否能跨模型、跨工具栈迁移，需要额外验证。

summary_en.core_problem: CODESKILL studies how a coding agent can turn past software-engineering trajectories into reusable procedural skills, and how those skills should be updated over time. The main problem is skill-bank management: what evidence to extract, how abstract the skill should be, and when to add, revise, merge, or drop skills, without updating the downstream coding agent itself.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is useful for post-training and agent self-improvement research. It reframes memory construction as a learnable policy rather than a set of fixed prompts and hand-written update rules. For researchers thinking about trajectory reuse, it shows a concrete route from raw interaction traces to compact procedural knowledge, optimized with downstream execution feedback.
summary_en.technical_approach: CODESKILL maintains a bank of markdown-style skills. Each skill contains a title, a trigger condition, and actionable instructions. Given a trajectory and relevant skill-bank context, the management model Mθ emits an operation: generate a new skill, evolve an existing one with new or failed experience, or maintain the bank through adding, merging, or removing entries. Training has two stages. The model is first warm-started with supervised data built from coding-agent trajectories and teacher-generated skill operations. It is then optimized with GRPO. The reward mixes sparse verifiable task feedback from a frozen downstream coding agent with dense rubric-based judgments of skill quality and behavior-skill alignment. This is a reasonable compromise: task success is the right objective but sparse, while judge feedback is denser but needs grounding in execution outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: The authors instantiate CODESKILL with Qwen3.5-4B and evaluate it on EnvBench, SWE-Bench Verified, and Terminal-Bench 2. CODESKILL improves average pass rate by 9.69 points over the no-skill baseline and by 4.01 points over the strongest prompt-based skill extraction or memory-construction baseline, corresponding to relative gains of about 33% and 11%. The reported gains hold on both in-domain and out-of-distribution software-engineering tasks. The clean part of the setup is that the downstream coding policy is frozen, so improvements can be attributed to the learned skill-management layer rather than to model weight updates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode of prompt-based memory, then focus on the CODESKILL section: skill representation, operation types, the Update procedure, and the GRPO reward. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against no-skill and prompt-based memory baselines. If ablations are included, the most informative ones are removing task feedback, removing rubric-based judgments, and disabling skill evolution or bank maintenance. A useful caveat to keep in mind is that the method learns an external memory layer for a frozen agent; transfer across base models, tool interfaces, and repository distributions remains the harder question.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和实验设置；skill bank 的 RL 管理比 prompt 规则干净，但先看是否真跑真实仓库任务。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and setup; RL-managed skill banks are cleaner than prompt heuristics, but the value depends on whether the tasks are real repository work.

summary.core_problem: 解决代码仓库 setup agent 在真实环境配置中难以跨仓库迁移经验、在不可逆状态下反复试错、以及可靠验证 setup 是否成功的问题。

summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者关注 functionality-correct repository setup 这一更贴近真实执行环境的任务，并与现有 LLM agents 比较其跨仓库迁移、multi-step repair 和 outcome verification 能力，但未给出 benchmark 规模、模型、成功率提升等关键数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Independent Researcher 与 Inspur 相关机构，但缺少可确认的知名团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles repository setup agents for real execution environments, where current systems struggle with cross-repository transfer, trial-and-repair under non-revertible states, and reliable verification of whether setup actually succeeded.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a software-engineering agent problem rather than a foundation-model pretraining problem, but the notions of learning from failures and handling irreversible environment states are mildly relevant to tool-using agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SetupX. Its core component is a Self-Evolving Experience Representation (XPU) that packages setup signals, textual guidance, and executable actions into transferable experience units. These are then reused in an experience-driven repair loop, with explicit verification to separate setup-induced failures from repository bugs.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the task is functionality-correct repository setup in realistic environments, and the comparisons focus on transfer, multi-step repair, and verification robustness against existing LLM agents. However, the abstract does not provide benchmark size, model details, or effect sizes.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes an Independent Researcher and an Inspur-affiliated institution, but no clearly identifiable well-known lab can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

paper.title: Ratchet: A Minimal Hygiene Recipe for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving skill libraries, pioneered by Voyager, let frozen LLM agents accumulate reusable knowledge without weight updates, yet recent evaluation shows that LLM-authored skills deliver $+0.0$pp over no-skill baselines while human-curated ones deliver $+16.2$pp: the bottleneck is not skill authoring but lifecycle management. We introduce \textbf{Ratchet}, a single-agent loop in which a frozen LLM writes, retrieves, curates, and retires its own natural-language skills. Ratchet integrates four

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“LLM 会不会写技能”，而是“自演化技能库为什么会越长越差”。作者把问题定位为 skill library 的生命周期管理失效：技能不断新增，但缺少稳定的去重、退役、容量约束和写作规范，结果是检索面被噪声稀释，重复技能堆积，边际无效甚至有害的技能长期留存。论文想回答的是：在不做权重更新、只靠外部自然语言技能记忆的前提下，最小需要哪些治理机制，才能让 self-evolving agent 不发散，并持续获得收益。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于 agent 应用本身，而在于它把“外部记忆/程序化经验”从 authoring 问题改写成了 data hygiene 问题。这个视角和预训练里的数据清洗、样本去重、容量控制、样本退火很接近。更具体地说，论文给出一个清楚结论：自生成经验之所以常常无效，不一定是模型不会总结，而是经验库缺少像训练数据管线那样的准入、归并和淘汰机制。这个结论对 continual pretrain、self-training、RLAIF/RL 自生成轨迹筛选都有启发。量级上，它不是改变范式的工作，但在“如何让模型用自己产生的数据继续变好”这个问题上，给了一个相当扎实的负责任答案。
summary.technical_approach:
方法很克制，核心是一个 frozen LLM 的单智能体闭环：写技能、检索技能、根据结果积累证据、再决定保留还是退役。系统里有四类对象。Skill 是 YAML 结构化技能，包含适用条件、关键 insight、常见坑和返回前检查项，并带向量表示用于检索。Meta-Skill 是更高层的写作规范，相当于给技能作者一个 schema lock 和风格先验。Capsule 记录一次任务-技能-尝试三元组的结果。Verdict 则由 critic 对失败样本做归因，判断某技能是 helped、hurt、neutral 还是 inapplicable，并给出 failure pattern。

每轮流程分五步。先在 held-out 集上做 eval pass，只路由 active skills，用来报告真实性能；再在 train split 上做 train pass，失败样本进入后续合成；critic 对失败 capsule 生成 verdict；synthesizer 从最近 W=6 轮的 verdict 中抽取模式并写新技能；最后 curator 根据证据日志做退役和容量控制。

真正有信息量的是四个 hygiene 机制。第一，pattern canonicalisation：对 critic 产出的 failure pattern 做相似度聚类和 union-find 合并，避免同一类 bug 被写成多个近重复技能。第二，outcome-driven retirement：对每个技能计算贡献分数 c_hat=(successes-failures)/trials，只有当试验数达到 N_min 后，且贡献低于负阈值 -tau，才退役。这比启发式“最近没用就删”更稳，因为它要求证据积累。第三，bounded active-cap：active skill 数量有硬上限 C，超出时淘汰贡献最低者，强制技能之间竞争检索位，避免库变大后 router 退化。第四，meta-skill authoring prior：不是单独做复杂 dedup，而是通过统一写作模板和风格约束，让新技能天然更规范、更少语义重复。作者的一个重要观察是，在这个规模下，显式 dedup 的收益大部分可被 authoring prior 吸收。

论文还有一个理论部分。命题 1 给出 non-divergence bound：如果没有有限 active-cap 和 retirement threshold，最坏情况下性能下界会变成 vacuous；只有 cap 和 threshold 都有限时，期望 pass@1 才能保证不会比 no-skill floor 低太多，误差项上界为 tau+epsilon+Cdelta。这个理论不复杂，但它把“为什么最小治理至少要有容量和退役”说清楚了。
summary.experiments:
主实验在 MBPP+ hard-100 上，用 Claude Opus 4.7 做 frozen backbone。无技能基线的 10-round rolling mean held-out pass@1 是 0.258±0.047。Ratchet 在 100 轮后，late-window rolling mean 到 0.584，三种随机种子的平均增益是 +0.328±0.018。对应的 forced-no-skill control 只有 +0.002±0.005，说明提升不是来自反复尝试或评测波动，而是来自技能库本身。

论文还报告了 SWE-bench Verified 上的 agentic solver 结果，峰值提升约 +0.22。作者把这作为“LLM 自写技能首次接近人类整理技能效果”的证据。这里需要保留一点审慎：SWE-bench 的方差和 agent pipeline 敏感性通常较高，最好结合附录看具体设置、样本量和 rolling/peak 的定义。

消融部分是全文最值得看的地方。作者做了 8 个 ablation，结论很明确。Meta-skill authoring prior 是 load-bearing，去掉后性能下降 -0.141；说明统一写作规范不仅改善可读性，更直接影响技能库冗余和检索质量。Retirement 机制也关键，但阈值过严会伤害性能，harsh retirement 带来 -0.019，说明过早淘汰会损失尚未积累足够证据、但潜在有用的技能。显式 dedup 在当前规模下不是主要矛盾，因为 authoring prior 已经吸收了大部分收益。频繁刷新 meta-skill 的 A8 只带来边际收益，却增加约 55% wall-time，说明高层 authoring prior 不需要高频重写，低频更新更划算。

另一个值得注意的实验设计是 train/eval 分离。技能是在 train split 的失败样本上合成，但报告性能只看 held-out eval pass，这让结果比很多“边学边测”的 agent 论文更可信一些。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，先看 Introduction 里对 SkillsBench 结果的重述，再看 Figure 1 和 Method 中五阶段流程，最后直接看 ablation 表。这样能抓住全文最重要的判断：瓶颈在 librarian，不在 author。

如果要精读，重点看三处。第一，Curator 的定义和 retirement 规则，理解为什么作者坚持 evidence floor 和 active-cap 这两个约束。第二，Meta-Skill 的设计，它其实是把“技能写作风格”变成一种上层数据规范，这一点和预训练数据 schema、合成数据模板控制很像。第三，Prop.1 的 non-divergence bound，虽然数学不重，但能帮助判断哪些机制是必要条件，哪些只是工程增强。

值得深挖的问题有两个。一个是贡献分数 c_hat 的定义比较粗，只看 successes-failures，没显式建模任务难度、技能交互和检索偏置；如果迁移到更复杂环境，可能需要 credit assignment 更细的估计器。另一个是技能表示仍是自然语言 YAML，未来如果换成程序化技能、latent skill 或可执行 verifier 约束，是否还能保留同样的 hygiene 结论，这很值得继续看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not really about whether an LLM can write useful skills. It is about why self-evolving skill libraries usually decay as they grow. The authors frame the failure as a lifecycle-management problem: skills keep being added, but there is no reliable mechanism for deduplication, retirement, capacity control, or authoring regularization. The result is library drift: retrieval gets diluted by redundancy and stale or harmful skills remain active. The central question is what minimal governance is required for a frozen model, using only external natural-language skills, to improve over time without diverging.
summary_en.importance: Its value to foundation-model research is indirect but real. The paper turns external memory from an authoring problem into a data-hygiene problem. That maps cleanly onto pretraining concerns such as deduplication, admission control, bounded replay buffers, and retirement of low-value synthetic data. The main lesson is that self-generated experience often fails not because the model cannot summarize, but because the memory pipeline lacks the equivalent of a disciplined data curation stack. This is relevant to continual pretraining, self-training, synthetic trajectory filtering, and RL pipelines that rely on model-produced supervision. It is not a paradigm-shifting result, but it is a careful answer to a recurring question: how do you let a model improve from its own outputs without updating weights?
summary_en.technical_approach:
Ratchet is a restrained design: a single frozen LLM runs a loop that writes skills, retrieves them, accumulates evidence from outcomes, and retires them when warranted. The system maintains four artifact types. A Skill is a structured YAML object with intent, applicability conditions, key insight, common pitfalls, and a verification checklist, plus an embedding for retrieval. A Meta-Skill is a higher-level authoring prior that provides a schema lock and stylistic guidance for writing new skills. A Capsule records one task-skill-attempt tuple. A Verdict is produced by a critic over failed capsules and labels whether a skill helped, hurt, was neutral, or was inapplicable, along with a short failure pattern.

Each round has five phases. An eval pass routes only active skills on held-out tasks and is used for reporting. A train pass runs on the train split and produces failures for synthesis. A critic converts failures into verdicts. A synthesizer looks at verdicts from the last W=6 rounds and may write new skills. A curator then updates contribution estimates and decides retirement or eviction.

The paper’s substance lies in four hygiene mechanisms. First, pattern canonicalization merges near-duplicate failure patterns using similarity-based union-find, so the same bug class does not spawn many redundant skills. Second, outcome-driven retirement computes a contribution score c_hat=(successes-failures)/trials and retires a skill only after it has accumulated at least N_min trials and its contribution falls below -tau. This is more stable than heuristic pruning because it requires evidence. Third, a bounded active-cap C limits the number of retrievable skills; if synthesis would exceed the cap, the lowest-contribution active skill is evicted. This forces competition for retrieval bandwidth and prevents degradation as the library grows. Fourth, a meta-skill authoring prior regularizes how new skills are written, reducing semantic duplication upstream rather than relying only on downstream filtering. One of the more interesting observations is that, at this scale, explicit deduplication is largely subsumed by the authoring prior.

There is also a small theoretical result. Proposition 1 gives a non-divergence bound showing that without both a finite active-cap and a retirement threshold, the worst-case lower bound becomes vacuous. With both in place, expected pass@1 cannot drift arbitrarily below the no-skill floor, with an error term bounded by tau+epsilon+Cdelta. The math is modest, but it clarifies why capacity control and retirement are the minimal governance primitives rather than optional engineering extras.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiment is on MBPP+ hard-100 using Claude Opus 4.7 as a frozen backbone. The no-skill baseline achieves a 10-round rolling-mean held-out pass@1 of 0.258±0.047. Ratchet reaches a late-window rolling mean of 0.584 over 100 rounds, with a 3-seed mean gain of +0.328±0.018. A forced-no-skill control improves by only +0.002±0.005, which is important: the gain is not from repeated attempts or evaluation noise, but from the managed skill library.

The paper also reports a peak lift of about +0.22 on SWE-bench Verified with an agentic solver. That is presented as evidence that LLM-authored libraries can close much of the gap to human-curated skills. This result is promising, though it should be read with some caution because SWE-bench pipelines are often sensitive to setup details and variance.

The ablations are the most informative part. Eight ablations isolate what the “librarian” actually does. The meta-skill authoring prior is clearly load-bearing: removing it costs -0.141, suggesting that standardized authoring materially improves retrieval quality and reduces redundancy. Retirement also matters, but overly aggressive retirement hurts; a harsh retirement setting costs -0.019, implying that early pruning can discard skills before enough evidence accumulates. Explicit deduplication is not the main bottleneck at this scale because the authoring prior already captures much of its benefit. Frequent meta-skill refresh in A8 yields only marginal gains while increasing wall-clock time by about 55%, so high-level authoring priors do not need to be rewritten often.

Another strong design choice is the train/eval separation. Skills are synthesized from failures on the train split, while reported performance comes from a held-out eval pass. That makes the empirical claim more credible than many agent papers that effectively learn and test on the same stream.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a fast read, start with the Introduction’s restatement of the SkillsBench result, then look at Figure 1 and the five-stage method, and finish with the ablation table. That is enough to capture the paper’s main claim: the bottleneck is the librarian, not the author.

For a closer read, focus on three places. First, the Curator and the retirement rule: this is where the paper makes its strongest argument for evidence floors and bounded capacity. Second, the Meta-Skill design: it effectively turns skill writing style into a higher-level data schema, which is conceptually close to template control in synthetic pretraining data. Third, Proposition 1: the theory is lightweight, but it helps separate necessary governance from optional implementation detail.

Two deeper questions are worth keeping in mind. The contribution score is deliberately simple and does not model task difficulty, skill interactions, or retrieval bias; a more complex environment may need better credit assignment. Also, the skills are still natural-language YAML artifacts. It would be interesting to test whether the same hygiene conclusions hold for executable skills, latent skills, or verifier-constrained procedural memories.

recommendation.zh: 读 hygiene ablation 就够了；有用的信号是 skill 数量上限和淘汰机制，而不是“自进化”叙事。
recommendation.en: Read the hygiene ablations; the useful signal is active-skill capping and retirement, not the self-evolution narrative.

summary.core_problem: 这篇仓库文档讨论的是：如何把 coding agent 用在性能敏感的 CUDA kernel 设计上，并把“写代码—验证—profile—迭代—晋级候选”做成一个可复用的工作流。

summary_en.core_problem: This repository is about structuring coding agents for performance-critical CUDA kernel work, turning research, implementation, verification, profiling, and iteration into a repeatable workflow.
summary_en.key_insights: The useful part is the process design rather than a new model. It formalizes a kernel task as a contract with constraints, validation commands, promotion criteria, and evidence tracking. The workflow emphasizes small-step implementation, benchmark/profiling-backed decisions, and preserving enough context for another engineer to understand what was tried and why a candidate was selected. That separation between agent planning and external evaluators is relevant for coding agents and automated systems work.
summary_en.limits: It reads as an early prototype repo, not a deep technical writeup. There is little quantitative evidence on reliability, cost, failure cases, or comparison against human experts and other agent setups. For pretraining researchers, the connection is indirect: it is more about agentized engineering loops than about new foundation-model training ideas.
